name: v3.10.1
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 3.10.0._

### Fixed

- **A data stream the container refuses no longer costs the subtitle track beside it (#539).** The
  tools that keep a source's subtitle and data streams through one helper (`fit`, `color`, `crop`,
  `stabilize`, `graphics`, `overlay`, `audio`, `loudness`, `proxy`, `deinterlace`, `denoise`,
  `redact`, `sphere`, `straighten`, `pad --end`, `freeze` of the last frame) retried without all of
  them when one failed: an MP4 with a mov_text track and a start timecode lost the track when
  written to `.mkv`, and on FFmpeg 6.1.1 to `.mp4` too. The data stream is now retried away alone,
  as `export.py` does; the `non_av_streams_dropped` fallback carries `dropped`, the stream types
  left out, and for a source with a subtitle and a data stream `dropped_non_av_streams` is false
  when the MP4 muxer wrote the timecode track itself (a source with a data stream and no subtitle
  still reports true after its retry). `color.py --retag`'s re-encode fallback has its own copy step and is not changed.
- **`metadata.py` refuses a stream the output container cannot take as a copy, before ffmpeg runs
  (#539).** A SubRip MKV written to `.mp4` (a mov_text MP4 to `.mkv`, a timecode track to Matroska,
  an attachment outside Matroska) failed inside ffmpeg after a dry run that said completed; it is
  `kind: input` now, a dry run included, with a hint naming `export.py --preset copy`. An MP4 with
  a start timecode, which FFmpeg 6.1.1 would not copy even into `.mp4`, is written: the timecode
  track alone is left out of the copy and the muxer writes it again (`.m4v` too). `.m4a` is judged
  as the MPEG-4 family it is: sound with a SubRip track is refused there as well.
- **A tool that writes a picture refuses an audio-only output extension (#539).** `fit`, `pad`,
  `speedramp`, `reverse`, `loop` and the other picture tools completed with H.264 inside `-o x.m4a`
  and failed in the muxer for `-o x.wav`. Both are refused before ffmpeg runs (`kind: input`,
  reason `output_extension_audio_only`), dry runs included; `metadata.py` refuses it for a source
  with a picture, and `waveform.py`'s own refusal carries the same reason. A stream copy by
  `sync.py --replace-audio` is not covered.
- **An audio output of `audio.py` or `loudness.py` keeps a late sound in place (#539).** A source
  whose sound starts after its picture was written from the sound's first sample, so a `.wav`,
  `.flac` or `.m4a` extraction played that much early. The lead is written as silence, as
  `cut.py --accurate` writes it, for the track `--audio-stream` selects, and reaches the encoder in
  frames of 4096 samples (FFmpeg 9's FLAC encoder refused the one large frame the pad produced).
  Beside a copied picture nothing changes.
- **`graphics.py`'s 0.3 s fades and the lower third's slide fit a short window (#539).** In a
  `--start`/`--end` window under 0.3 s the text never faded out, and between 0.3 and 0.6 s its
  brightness jumped; the lower third's bar jumped back in a window under 0.7 s. Each fade is cut
  to half the window and the slide shares it 4:3, on drawtext and on the ASS route; the sticker's
  pop is cut with its fade on both routes, and a lower third whose slides fill the window draws no
  rest phase (its emoji showed for one frame).

Checked on FFmpeg 6.1.1 (Linux) only. Left open in #539 for a decision: `caption.py`'s burn and
`waveform.py` drop the source's subtitle track, and `cut.py -o x.mka` re-encodes a picture into the
`.mka`.
- fix: a refused stream costs only itself, and an output is what its name says (#554)



## What's Changed
* fix: a refused stream costs only itself, and an output is what its name says by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/554


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/compare/v3.10.0...v3.10.1

name: v3.10.0
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 3.9.3._

### Changed

- **A `render.py` project of several clips takes its picture size from the `fit` object, as a
  one-clip project does, in the render and in `--export-timeline` (#526).** fit.py gets the
  `fit` object's aspect, mode, width and height and the frame's only where the object has none,
  and the exported sequence (FCPXML, EDL, OTIO) is sized, and timed, from the same merge.
  Before, a multi-clip render fitted the object inside the joined picture and the export sized
  the sequence from `frame` alone, so the two disagreed. Over two 160x120 clips: frame 16:9 with
  `fit` 1:1 rendered 120x120 against a 160x90 sequence (now both 120x120); frame `{aspect 16:9,
  width 320}` with `fit {aspect 4:5, fit crop}` rendered 192x240 against 320x180 (now 320x400);
  frame 1:1 with `fit {width 200}` exported 120x120 (now 200x200, as rendered); frame
  `{width 320, height 180}` with `fit` 1:1 rendered 180x180 (now 320x180, as exported: two
  sides given are kept, as for one clip); frame 16:9 at 25 fps with `fit {fps 24}` exported a
  25 fps sequence (now 24, as rendered). A frame of one side now gives join.py the other side
  rounded as fit.py rounds it: `{width 100}` over 4:3 clips rendered 100x74 against a 100x76
  sequence (now 100x76). Where the `fit` object gives that side itself the join is sized from it
  (`{width 100}` with `fit {width 200}`: 200x150 both), and a key the `fit` object gives as `null` counts
  as not given, in the render as in the export. The clips are joined at the rate the render delivers, the
  `fit` object's where it gives one: joined at the frame's 25 fps and conformed to `fit {fps 24}`, two
  0.7 s clips rendered 35 frames against a 34-frame sequence. A multi-clip export now refuses a `fit.aspect` or `fit.fit` that fit.py
  refuses, as a one-clip export already did. One-clip projects render and export as before.
  Which multi-clip projects change is listed in `docs/design-decisions.md` ("After 3.9.3").
- feat: a render of several clips takes its size from fit, and its timeline says so (#553)



## What's Changed
* feat: a render of several clips takes its size from fit, and its timeline says so by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/553


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/compare/v3.9.3...v3.10.0

name: v3.9.3
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 3.9.2._

### Fixed

- **`.aif`, `.aiff` and `.caf` outputs are written; a `.wma` output the run would encode into is refused (#517).** The audio
  extensions the skill reads were wider than the ones it had a codec for, and the rest were taken
  for a video container: `cut.py` (except a stream copy of PCM), `audio.py`, `silence.py` and
  `loudness.py` given `-o x.aiff`
  (or `.aif`, `.caf`) failed inside ffmpeg (`kind: ffmpeg`) after a dry run had planned it, an
  audio `join.py` refused it as a video container and `render.py`'s podcast delivery as a copied
  `.mp4`. They are written as 16-bit PCM (`pcm_s16be`, the AIFF and CAF muxers' own codec; a
  stream copy keeps a PCM source's), lossless like `.wav`, so a bitrate is refused for them. (`cut.py --accurate` reports `precision: sample` for them, as for `.wav`.) `-o
  x.wma` completed, verified, with H.264 and AAC in an ASF file; a run that would encode into `.wma`
  is now refused as `kind: input` (reason `output_extension_unsupported`, a hint naming the
  extensions the tools write), dry runs included, whether the name came from `-o` or a `.wma`
  input's default, and before `loudness.py`'s and `silence.py`'s measuring pass. A stream copy of
  WMA sound into `.wma` (`cut.py` without `--accurate`, `--segments` too, and `metadata.py`) is
  kept, as it was; a copy that `cut.py`'s length check would re-encode is refused instead, the
  copy removed (`--tolerance -1` keeps it). A copy that fails leaves the file `--overwrite` named untouched. A `render.py` project is
  refused where it would write a `.wma`: a single uncut WMA clip no stage touches is delivered as it
  was, and a `--stop-after` preview is not refused for a delivery it does not write. Checked on FFmpeg 6.1.1 by probing the written files
  (wmav1 and wmav2 sources).
- **A still picture given to `export.py` or `join.py` is refused as an input, naming `insert.py`
  (#531).** `export.py STILL` wrote one frame (0.04 s) with `verified: true` in each preset tried
  (`youtube`, `reels`, `h265`, `prores`, `copy`, and `prores4444` from an RGBA still; `gif` failed
  in its muxer), and every preset is now refused; `join.py` joined one frame
  under `--transition none`, refused a transition as "too short" (and planned it in a dry run), and
  refused `--copy` as a stream mismatch. Each is now the refusal `cut.py` and the others give a still
  since 3.9.0, a dry run included; `insert.py STILL --duration T` makes the clip. A `render.py`
  project with a still clip meets it through its join or export stage.
- fix: aif, aiff and caf outputs are written, a .wma encode is refused; a still given to export or join is refused (#550)



## What's Changed
* fix: aif, aiff and caf outputs are written, a .wma encode is refused; a still given to export or join is refused by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/550


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/compare/v3.9.2...v3.9.3

name: v1.4.261
body:
[Previous release: 1.4.259](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.259) — Major performance improvements, automatic cleanup and focused subagent views.

## Major performance improvements, Cursor Chat & a customizable + menu ✨

Orca 1.4.261 makes busy Chat workflows more responsive and releases memory from browser pages you haven't used in hours. Cursor joins Chat, and a customizable + menu puts your preferred ways to open tabs within reach.

- ⚡ **Move between busy chats with less waiting:** Long conversations load their history in pages, and background replies do less work in the sidebar and hidden chats when you switch conversations.
- 🌐 **Keep browser tabs without keeping every page loaded:** Memory Saver frees eligible pages after four hours out of view by default, then reloads them when you return. Sites using session cookies can also keep you signed in across restarts.
- 🤖 **Use Cursor in Chat:** Start with the Cursor sign-in on your computer, choose a model, effort and Fast, approve commands, and reopen the conversation later.
- ➕ **Make the + menu yours:** Use the gear beside the new icon row to reorder actions, hide unused choices and set shortcuts. Hidden actions remain available through search and their shortcuts.
- ⌨️ **Carry terminal work forward accurately:** Copy Context, Fork and Continue preserve spaces drawn by terminal programs. Edit → Paste targets the split pane that actually has focus.

## Highlights

- **More room for active work:** Memory Saver also applies to browser tabs on an updated `orca serve` host. Desktop tabs retain their title, history, cookies and saved site data. Settings → Browser lets you change the idle interval or turn Memory Saver off.
- **More agent choices:** Antigravity Chat works on Windows, and Pi Chat shows subagents. Ordinary Orca CLI commands avoid Electron startup on supported Macs; macOS 13.4 retains the existing launcher.
- **Workspaces at a glance:** Experimental workspace cards show activity, unread results, failures and offline hosts. Choose Classic or Experimental from Workspace options. Agents whose panes are asleep keep showing Done.
- **Phone navigation:** The paired phone interface gains desktop project groups and a shared browser preference for chat and terminal links, including Ask each time. On desktop, Take back all returns control of phone-driven browser tabs. 

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat history:** Existing chats convert to the new store in the background or when first opened. Original chat files stay in place in this release. After downgrading and upgrading again, chats continued in the older version are recovered; a previously converted conversation can appear beside its newer version as a second chat.
- **Browser reloads:** Freed pages reload in place; scroll position and page-only memory can reset. Desktop Memory Saver leaves pages loaded when it detects unsaved edits or cannot safely assess them. Savings depend on which pages qualify.
- **Android:** The legacy app directs users to install the new `dev.orca.app` separately; it cannot update into the new package. This desktop release does not install a phone app.
- **Finished agents:** Rows leave workspace cards, the Agents list and dashboard when the process exits or its SSH host disconnects. Sleeping panes retain their Done status.

---

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Phone chats, links, browser hand-back, project groups and the Android app move.*

name: Orca Mobile Android android-v0.0.67
body:
[Previous Android release: 0.0.66](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/android-v0.0.66)

## An easier path to Android updates ✨

This Android beta update makes it easier to move a GitHub-installed copy of Orca to Google Play for future updates.

- 📱 **Open the right update page:** Eligible GitHub installs now open the Google Play listing from the home update card, Settings, and the update-required screen.
- 🌏 **Keep the APK option where you need it:** Phones detected as being in mainland China, or without an installed and enabled Play Store, continue to use GitHub releases.

## Highlights

**For GitHub installs:** The new routing applies to the current Android app, `dev.orca.app`. It uses your device's language-region and time-zone settings to detect mainland China. If region detection fails, Orca keeps the GitHub route.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

This release's APK is available in the assets below. Existing Play installs continue to receive updates through Play. The retired Android app's migration screen is unchanged.

## What's Changed

The full source changes between these Android tags are listed below. Desktop changes require a desktop update.

### Android updates & installation

*Route eligible Android update actions to Google Play and retain APK download guidance.*

* docs: lead Android links with Google Play, keep the APK as the fallback by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43084
* feat(mobile): steer GitHub installs outside mainland China to Google Play by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43080

### Desktop chat & agents

*Keep saved chats retryable after temporary restore failures and preserve unopened chat statuses.*

* fix(acp): keep saved chats retryable after temporary restore failures by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42981
* Preserve unopened chat statuses during eviction by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43061

### Desktop browser

*Open SSH-host links in Orca when browsing runs on this device.*

* fix(browser): open SSH links in Orca when the host browses from this device by @shcheglovnd in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41589

### Desktop Tasks

*Reorder Jira board lanes by dragging their headers.*

* feat(jira): reorder the Tasks board lanes by dragging their headers by @kazuki-hanai in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30597

### Plugins

*Refresh the catalog before previewing an update.*

* fix(plugins): re-fetch the catalog before an update preview by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43063

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Update the Android app version and version code.*

* chore(mobile): bump to 0.0.67 and Android versionCode 31 by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43086

## New Contributors
* @shcheglovnd made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41589

### Verify your download

- Size: `146062113` bytes
- SHA-256: `9e78f5f2e304bf1956c4b81394babdb1e265980dbbafc73319d0dfeeae88533d`
- Signing certificate SHA-256: `A0:A6:67:69:42:B2:DE:E1:F3:5F:B0:F6:FC:A0:AE:63:B5:65:4E:42:6C:A3:1A:DA:4C:F9:BE:09:2B:D7:DA:07`

A "no certificate" or "problem parsing the package" install failure is usually a truncated download — check the size first, then `sha256sum -c app-release.apk.sha256` (`shasum -a 256 -c` on macOS).

name: Orca Mobile Android android-v0.0.66
body:
[Previous release: Android 0.0.65](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/android-v0.0.65)

## Open Orca without the Google Play startup block—and keep your place in chat ✨

Android 0.0.66 removes the installer license check that could close Orca when Google Play was disabled or unreachable. Download the APK attached to this release to update the `dev.orca.app` Android app.

- 📱 **Get past the startup error:** This APK no longer carries the check behind “Check that Google Play is enabled on your device,” so that check won't prevent you from opening Orca.
- 💬 **Read several chats without losing your place:** Switch away from a transcript and return to the spot you were reading, with opened tool runs kept open. Chats already at the latest message continue following new replies.
- 🗂️ **Find work in familiar project groups:** With **Group by Project**, your phone shows the desktop's nested groups and ordering. Collapsing a group stays in sync between devices.
- 🔗 **Choose where chat and terminal links open:** One **Settings → Browser → Open links** preference covers both workflows. Open links on your phone, in Orca's desktop browser, or choose each time.

## Highlights

- **Navigate long replies:** Tap the **↑** beneath a chat reply to return to its beginning. Tap **↓** to get back to the latest output. **Wrap lines** on code blocks now stays selected through streaming and transcript redraws, making long code easier to read on a narrow screen.
- **Keep browsing flexible:** **Ask each time** offers the desktop browser, the phone browser and Copy link. Existing saved browser choices carry over. If a desktop browser tab cannot open, the phone browser handles the link instead.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- This release provides a GitHub APK for Android; it does not establish availability on Google Play's public production track or the iOS App Store.
- Project groups need a paired desktop that supplies group information; older hosts can still show a flat list. Update the paired desktop for host-side improvements listed below.
- Chat reading positions and opened tool runs are remembered while the chat page remains open, rather than saved permanently across app restarts.

name: v0.9.56
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.56

Released on 2026-11-16.

Studio's preview and the local servers now act only for their own pages. The CLI keeps its cache, history and restores inside the project. The arm64 Lambda image ships only the reviewed ffmpeg build, and large previews build faster.

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** The composition file servers no longer serve credential or tool-state files ([014326b40](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/014326b40bf22bebb77a5cf08a50d5b0968c112e), [#7889](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7889)).
- **Studio Server:** Lint and probe run only for requests from Studio's own pages ([bbac8900e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bbac8900ea9201dca8aacdd17387e3275a9e6d84), [#7894](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7894)).
- **Studio Server:** A history restore stays inside the project and uses only intact copies ([478313ba0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/478313ba0e674d51c3b307afa862de8dd87afcf9), [#7902](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7902)).
- **Studio:** Take playback works for a preview its server made opaque ([1e542956d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1e542956d978ceb6be9e50c8396ffdcf2c0fc433), [#7815](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7815)).
- **Studio:** The preview frame keeps the sandbox origin its host set ([b650d0d19](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b650d0d198bae4dfd440ba2bad32b4a2351862aa), [#7886](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7886)).
- **Studio:** Present decks open only in their own site, and the preview reads only its own frame's messages ([4067efc45](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4067efc454382463979f0625e8e031a73ff05b9d), [#7877](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7877)).
- **Core:** The runtime bridge checks each control message before acting on it ([97d8f26e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/97d8f26e713987cbb9f2ba6cb7d45eb3481a9093), [#7892](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7892)).
- **CLI:** `render --docker` keeps the host's page-network restriction inside the container ([5d8605eb8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5d8605eb8e56fa6de714482e99c9f63cd258581a), [#7890](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7890)).
- **CLI:** `preview --stop` stops only the process the system reports holding the port ([ace8a78dc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ace8a78dcc14499b82b077301bcc4633c99e66c6), [#7882](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7882)).
- **CLI:** The check cache is saved only as a project record, never through a linked file ([7801e3ff3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7801e3ff346f65d994ef64d9c5d067f3dcd52b87), [#7884](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7884)).
- **CLI:** History turn ids read from the project folder are checked and sent encoded ([6efa6b635](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6efa6b63536970758b56c210d12ec581c4e82261), [#7883](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7883)).
- **CLI:** Catch-up lists only the turns the app added after the hand-off ([0f23f40f8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0f23f40f8b06761a57922c85721209d6c4943f25), [#7874](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7874)).
- **CLI:** A received-files record in a folder under the project counts for a render ([1c159c550](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1c159c550d27d267a9ee8d0d6759691147cd8a1d), [#7900](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7900)).
- **CLI:** Media-use copies only the sound effects its bundled index names ([ed93a1312](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ed93a131251a1ae6c21fd3908c86f9972765d5c6), [#7895](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7895)).
- **Media Use:** Local models start from a folder outside the project ([756c2c6c1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/756c2c6c1b3446873e0e5547f1f5c02697293acf), [#7888](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7888)).
- **Engine:** A cached browser is used only when its files match the pinned build ([56a2d0c53](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/56a2d0c53ff8d3353ad0e0c56d518e8862484ac4), [#7865](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7865)).
- **Engine:** Timeline frame predictions stay within the render's frames ([f5a74a567](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5a74a567884443e136762a39b2c0bac1a9f43d9), [#7885](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7885)).
- **Engine:** Each superset extraction works in a folder of its own ([a4139e9ea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a4139e9ead02bea455feb3409c0076d2de050896), [#7901](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7901)).
- **Parsers:** Reading a canvas scaffold's width and height takes the same short time on any input ([b856a1d63](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b856a1d63fed7443bcdad5b2246983e33f7e3aac), [#7873](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7873)).
- **Lint:** Agent-made scenes and sound effects stay on one timeline lane ([98208241e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98208241e7800122607db651d961bcc26a724077), [#7775](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7775)).
- **Skills:** Standalone installs run the CLI through its launcher too ([3fc3050bc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3fc3050bc38a41f76a39ab50e075bdbf13120418), [#7879](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7879)).
- **AWS Lambda:** A release ships the arm64 ffmpeg only when it matches the digest committed beside its build ([d9488119b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d9488119beb6470015fcfb9e21f90a384baf822c), [#7872](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7872)).

## Performance

- **Core:** A preview build reads a large page without copying it on every pass ([082d63683](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/082d63683f8b599c35fda3567ca1ed0659a30cac), [#7878](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7878)).
- **Producer:** Compile and render-telemetry tag scans take time in step with the page's size ([82fdf406c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/82fdf406c43851ac75a82a0d49aa944cdc955254), [#7896](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7896)).

## Internal

- **Publish:** Every npm publish waits on the npm-publish approval ([a54de748e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a54de748ee3d89d05ff8c0b0bedcf65c8714b661), [#7870](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7870)).
- **Publish:** Prebuilt tarballs publish from a job that runs no code from the release commit ([af0560c85](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/af0560c8598a5196f51bb45baf406ae50a213c6b), [#7869](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7869)).
- **CI:** Publishing workflows run only for main ([7bd6b9daf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7bd6b9daf89faf95b6ed46dbd6b84ec8c5de1c00), [#7875](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7875)).
- **CI:** Test fixtures no longer look like real HeyGen keys, and CI rejects one that does ([5dc3b336a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5dc3b336aa186f7e2e019ee8039f195befe8383a), [#7876](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7876)).

name: v0.9.55
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.55

Released on 2026-11-15.

A sealed Studio preview now plays a video's proxy copy and reloads under one current frame token. Cloud render sends one zip when it fits and uploads only the largest media. The file servers check the Host they are asked under, and publish and cloud render staging skip other computers' network shares.

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** Sub-composition head and root tag scans take linear time ([ceb969dba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ceb969dbacff281ec1fdddf9fe22c0fcd34fb663), [#7866](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7866)).
- **CLI:** The engine and CLI share one trusted PATH rule, and a skipped project copy says why ([e2430edec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e2430edecf5492a02a363eaa5c30ad2708af5aee), [#7801](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7801)).
- **CLI:** Cloud render sends one zip when it fits and uploads only the largest media ([9bc2b231d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9bc2b231d339609a3f2f48b63f80b162a3d97a4d), [#7859](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7859)).
- **Docs:** The engine docs say download limits apply per attempt and per process ([4c09c8b79](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4c09c8b7937eb8972b947df06dd187608ff02345), [#7867](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7867)).
- **CLI:** Upload archives never include credential or agent-state files ([52d43f33a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/52d43f33a3102e3fadfbe3d6d24f18c9f2ea689e), [#7830](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7830)).
- Static, producer and engine file servers check Host and mark runtime pages ([490199cef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/490199cef8475e65eaa166b23bbf1f3034d272a9), [#7852](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7852)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview's reload asks under one current frame token ([1f17b3dfe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1f17b3dfebf9cc1bfd20107c089151e0e8b07910), [#7862](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7862)).
- **CLI:** Publish and cloud render staging skip other computers' network shares ([c030e3193](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c030e3193d0d5e910d0d03d0a881848b35cdc44d), [#7858](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7858)).
- **Studio Server:** A sealed preview's wait for a video's proxy copy passes its preflight ([ae5829db7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ae5829db7e96675060eb810ac03139d60156b10e), [#7856](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7856)).
- **CLI:** Subfolder renders read an ancestor's record however it is stored or spelled ([fe21bee3c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fe21bee3cf40007c23e7a3ad7dc7a2cf08f5df20), [#7847](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7847)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.54

Released on 2026-11-15.

Studio hosts can now run the preview on its own sealed origin with the sandboxOrigin option or VITE_STUDIO_OPAQUE_PREVIEW_ENABLED, off by default. When sealed, the preview's images, media, fetched files, console errors panel and GSAP keyframe and 3D previews keep working. Render, capture and bundling also leave out the app's own .hyperframes records.

## Features

- **Studio:** Hosts can share the preview's editing-port client ([3a4f57252](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3a4f57252377051f6602bd0149e84f8ead0845b2), [#7811](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7811)).
- **Studio:** Hosts can seal the preview frames NLEPreview draws ([a73ecff2b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a73ecff2bef2168c47625e781bc1de13c7ca23ce), [#7817](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7817)).
- **Studio:** The console errors panel reads a sealed preview over its editing port ([5341d7255](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5341d7255c4795a9dda676cb21409a4655b2e429), [#7824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7824)).
- **Studio Server:** An opaque preview loads its images, media and fetched files ([88ffe087c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/88ffe087cae5d005fdc3d7b9567283c72a9ba5d7), [#7806](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7806)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** Check scheme-prefixed media sources against the project folder ([d8e36aa9d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d8e36aa9dc7b4c007cbcb6bc0be0dcb21c1205bc), [#7851](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7851)).
- **Docs:** The v0.9.53 notes list the key rules moving into core ([c46143dd7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c46143dd7904204c6dc0a2e574607d8dab238496), [#7855](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7855)).
- Answer only the loopback Host on the render and capture file servers ([f891a3058](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f891a305812e9046777e32ff49eef83afe9bf7f5), [#7853](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7853)).
- **Engine:** Remote downloads get an absolute deadline and stop before the disk fills ([e1043659d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1043659d4490fde8458063a9585c30478464c8d), [#7827](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7827)).
- **CLI:** The audio caches never write or read through links in .hyperframes ([9701f0639](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9701f0639c3614f4fb33f2a83973adafd179ef08), [#7825](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7825)).
- **Parsers:** Helper programs never come from the project a subfolder sits in ([96cc8cb85](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/96cc8cb85242fc72bb2e1371048d733cb4993c68), [#7845](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7845)).
- **CLI:** A project .env key is used only when nothing is saved ([de1ce6898](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/de1ce68988a6cce48a73a67a8d2c2b7fb4603bad), [#7848](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7848)).
- **CLI:** Keep project text and other computers' shares out of render and upload notices ([70d60ce03](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70d60ce03719030bda362d6c7107a9fa350c6090), [#7849](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7849)).
- **Studio:** GSAP keyframe and 3D previews stop throwing on a sealed preview ([39dc1e232](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/39dc1e232d242cdecf9ad782483587b288cc1392), [#7833](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7833)).
- Snapshot escapes composition text in its output; stills sweep the transcode cache ([a2f926708](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a2f926708901f1fc52c18888db103cd768537824), [#7832](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7832)).
- Render, capture and bundling refuse the app's .hyperframes records ([962ddb7c5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/962ddb7c543519be17f6085a9c105d29d5886ecc), [#7828](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7828)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.53

Released on 2026-11-15.

Pages with many Chinese, Japanese or Korean characters now load their fonts in a few small requests, so they render instead of timing out. Cloud render no longer refuses a file that only an unused page names, and uploads now list every file they carry from outside the project.

## Features

- **CLI:** Uploads list every file they carry from outside the project ([e426ce4eb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e426ce4eb44517db3f65105f1e05cb7b762cd950), [#7831](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7831)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** Shader transitions blend in Node when the page cannot composite them ([fb1a383bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb1a383bde6a0716fdc6041bf68b9bc1da9726b5), [#7840](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7840)).
- **CLI:** The upload cut test stops failing on busy Windows runners ([2ea78c0ab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ea78c0ab462e506cec44d3c969513d8aa244749), [#7843](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7843)).
- **Engine:** Restricted downloads apply the capture proxy's address rule ([125a9446b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/125a9446be3c0736a190c16cef9003108b0a981c), [#7839](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7839)).
- LAN-host previews and play pages refuse other sites without fetch metadata ([2ceb682f9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ceb682f925c867faf16fc68ce7872333286e66c), [#7836](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7836)).
- **CLI:** Benchmark keeps received files' rule; a received .env key never replaces a login ([a7266e4c8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7266e4c8385dfbf9d7b7a81813fe984c46f9dad), [#7837](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7837)).
- **CLI:** Cloud render no longer refuses a file only an unused page names ([45cc331e5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/45cc331e54b28040694a47e540ddc2d100cacdf3), [#7812](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7812)).
- **Core:** Pages with many CJK characters fetch fonts in several requests ([6a8f4b5b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6a8f4b5b46762e6b1631e02d6d77b29b950c88ee), [#7823](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7823)).
- **CLI:** Hyperframes audio never looks up media on another computer's share ([eaf33bc65](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eaf33bc658fbd2612753a48574fed6f9e376a511), [#7826](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7826)).
- **CLI:** Uploads leave out outside scripts; .ts counts as video only when it is one ([04202e8a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04202e8a4c2e7f334636bf1e3b07dd38c77e5b43), [#7818](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7818)).
- **CLI:** Play and present check the Host like preview; local render leaves out outside files for a received composition ([ac0247410](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac02474105bc6d2893a0ef1a79526f2952645aca), [#7792](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7792)).
- Studio media routes refuse cross-site load, CLI escapes terminal text, batch outputs stay in their folder ([c4d60c347](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4d60c347f324eb58dacfccee866a0b9bba7fe61), [#7779](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7779)).
- **CLI:** Discover mounted scenes inside templates ([a75e61f31](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a75e61f31c76d79016894e849799bdc456ac0b54), [#7822](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7822)).
- **Studio Server:** History lock records are replaced, never written through links ([0248ea033](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0248ea033c74c31527f5657419abf83ec3602091), [#7821](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7821)).
- **Producer:** Keep the render server local unless a token guards it ([f667111d1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f667111d179ec93edb8e8e9b29d846c20d15ed0f), [#7814](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7814)).
- **Engine,cli:** The playlist folder check reads HLS as ffmpeg does; snapshot runs it too ([797a622be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/797a622be96143439d3fce94da169b9665106293), [#7810](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7810)).
- **Engine,producer:** Render-network setting reads like a switch; render-service probes stay on checked inputs ([be740d021](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be740d0215f027f6987d69dfa75602279ab5af25), [#7807](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7807)).
- **CLI:** Printed Windows commands read folder names literally in every shell ([a07d4cf73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a07d4cf738c83eb113b4b2a640ca293ba4b0ce92), [#7769](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7769)).
- **CLI:** Nested received records only add; a received .env never picks the account; font names stay out of agent files ([80b09cc94](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80b09cc94aad9b85484adbc8617cdc648206d6b3), [#7808](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7808)).
- Cloud Run renders reach only public addresses; frame cache folder is private to its user ([55b514709](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/55b51470980ce8ef0c5533b26de01c116d4c4987), [#7777](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7777)).
- **Deps:** Refresh zod, smol-toml, aws-cdk-lib and related resolutions in bun.lock ([28d4ba50f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/28d4ba50f1263b97bbb3d9ca1655833e0f3dad53), [#7741](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7741)).
- **Deps:** Bump @mcp-b/global to 6.1.0 to clear @modelcontextprotocol/server advisories ([beeb17e85](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/beeb17e85af0dfa696d9621c634f50250c539b8d), [#7742](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7742)).
- **Engine:** A failed parallel capture names the worker that failed, not the peers it stopped ([db6b7478a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/db6b7478a7e66415b8c35da4126dcaee687026de), [#7803](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7803)).
- **Engine:** Render refusals name the address an IPv6-mapped or NAT64 host carries ([04ee926d9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04ee926d9740e4112a458c8f7946e7be069caee2), [#7802](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7802)).
- **Producer:** Accept browser requests only under loopback, IP or listed host names ([03e6a1a18](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/03e6a1a1807d2a98d83b86cc364fcc2fd69d4c40), [#7798](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7798)).
- **Parsers:** Never look up media on another computer's share ([2de5c027f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2de5c027fa02baed483a7ffc6cc5d9c18f92a79e), [#7797](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7797)).
- **CLI:** Upload archives always leave out env files and private records ([477a3aea1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/477a3aea139a3fca372562cd0681f297843f0a1b), [#7796](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7796)).
- **Engine:** Bound remote media downloads by size, encoding and throughput ([5111cf384](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5111cf3840c37267f954f4e7a4f64a99b1bc0fdc), [#7786](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7786)).
- **CLI:** Start helper programs only from trusted PATH folders on every platform ([83eae240f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/83eae240fb5f5747c94b6aabdc5448e59f119a5e), [#7787](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7787)).

## Performance

- **Lint:** Scan CSS url references in linear time ([bcf3d177d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bcf3d177d3476a1696b034544f5cfcf68404663b), [#7829](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7829)).
- CSS url, @import, @font-face, style and comment scans run in linear time ([ded5e3eec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ded5e3eec25cd2da405fb30c2751d6406726607d), [#7809](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7809)).

## Catalog

- **CLI:** Add lists files from a received config's registry as received ([6a7b4df7c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6a7b4df7c8bb04944b14820570b2dd7a32e76dc7), [#7820](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7820)).
- **Catalog:** Payload check treats the optional caption-overrides.json as absent, not failed ([b7c26ff84](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b7c26ff844ed1d0eea616be3536da1bb0dd404bc), [#7813](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7813)).
- **Registry:** Caption keywords, emoji and aftershock work for words outside a-z ([8dbbc1d37](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8dbbc1d371ca73341d18eff5aba86737f6355309), [#7804](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7804)).
- **Docs:** Check catalog link values and keep them out of copied commands ([7c7ff6d89](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7c7ff6d89e99e81002dc919ae6d7b34193d6d202), [#7783](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7783)).

# last30days v4.0.5

X searches now return the posts people actually engaged with.

- X keyword searches read X's Latest tab, which is ordered by time. On a busy topic that meant the last few minutes of posts, nearly all with zero engagement. Searches now read the Top tab across the whole 30-day window. On a live check, Taylor Swift went from 13 posts with 1 like in total to 28 posts with 212,731 likes, and Claude Code from 20 likes to 67,837 likes for the same 12 posts.
- Handle discovery gets better as a side effect. It used to promote whoever happened to post in those few minutes and spend searches on them. It now picks accounts that matter for the topic.
- Searches of a specific account's posts and mentions still read Latest, so no post in the window is missed.

Coming from 4.0.3? See the 4.0.4 notes for the line-spacing fix to KEY PATTERNS and follow-up suggestions.

body:
# last30days v4.0.2

Fixes from a Grok Bot run on Microsoft (#1449), measured on the same run before and after:

- Prediction-market odds are real again. An outcome with an empty order book no longer reports a meaningless midpoint, and a set of mutually exclusive ranges that still adds up to far over 100% is hidden. Microsoft's weekly close went from 46% / 44% / 40% to 14% / 8.5% / 8.0%.
- Hiring Signals shows different roles under each theme. Themes read the job title, department, and the role's own description, not the company text every posting repeats. Repeated examples on Microsoft went from 3 to 0.
- The top 8 stories cover more than one event. One story takes at most 3 of the 8 slots, each searched angle gets a slot, and old evidence stays behind current stories. Microsoft's top 8 went from 8 outage stories to the outage plus AI and earnings.
- Top voices are the accounts people engaged with, not the ones that posted most. A headline reposter with ten zero-like posts no longer outranks the company's own account.
- Source health tells the truth. A YouTube bot check gets its own advice instead of "upgrade yt-dlp", the host plan no longer adds sources that cannot run, and Techmeme searches only the research window.
- Company resolution stops getting rate-limited by Wikidata (#1447).

name: v4.0.0
body:
# last30days v4.0.0

## Before you upgrade: sidecar cookies now need consent

On Linux, Mac mini, and Darwin sink hosts, the agentcookie sidecar no longer reads X cookies just because it is installed. If you rely on it, set `AGENTCOOKIE=on` (or an affirmative `BROWSER_CONSENT`) in `~/.config/last30days/.env`. Explicit refusals still win, and direct `AUTH_TOKEN` + `CT0` credentials keep working. `/last30days doctor` tells you when an installed sidecar needs the opt-in. Thanks to @vincentkoc (#1365, landed in #1440).

## What's new

- Secret Signals in plain words. Patent and jobs signals are two sentences: what the filing or role is, and what it could mean. A patent shows up only when it is out of character for the company or describes a product it hasn't shipped, and the two strongest candidates are checked on the web first (#1427, #1428).
- Company-run job boards. A company report now reads the company's own careers site, either directly (Amazon, Apple, Google, IBM, Eightfold boards for Microsoft, Qualcomm, and Netflix) or by detecting its hiring platform (Oracle, JPMorgan, Dell, AMD, Adobe, Cisco, Disney, Salesforce, Intel, and others). Sites with only a job sitemap get a titles-only digest. Set `LAST30DAYS_JOBS_RESPECT_ROBOTS=1` to honor robots.txt (#1428, #1431).
- Gemini model pins. A stale `LAST30DAYS_PLANNER_MODEL` or `LAST30DAYS_RERANK_MODEL` pin warns and falls back instead of failing, and Gemini 4+ is accepted. Thanks to @SajjadPSavoji (#1430, landed in #1439).
- Grok Bot run fixes. `--as-of` set to today is a live run, an outdated Digg helper reports its upgrade command, a missing stock helper is named, and post-write checks no longer delete required sections (#1427).

## Contributors

Thank you @vincentkoc and @SajjadPSavoji.

## What's Changed
* fix: show patent signals only when surprising, and fix the Grok Bot run by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1427
* feat: plain-words Secret Signals and company-run job boards by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1428
* feat(jobs): read company boards by hiring platform, with a sitemap tier and fall-through by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1431
* fix(providers): accept Gemini 4+ and fall back from stale model pins (from #1430 by @SajjadPSavoji) by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1439
* docs: README tracks the v4 pipeline by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1441
* fix(agentcookie): require positive consent for sidecar cookie reads (from #1365 by @vincentkoc) by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1440
* chore(release): bump version to 4.0.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1442

name: v0.10.0
body:
# GPUI Kit v0.10.0

GPUI Kit 0.10.0 is a minor release. It moves the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.16, adds global right-to-left layout, an explicit reduced-motion preference, roving keyboard navigation in Tabs, opt-in match highlighting in Select / Combobox / Command, and a long run of input, text, table and accessibility fixes. Two small breaking changes in the input API make this a minor release.

## Breaking Changes

- **Textarea**: `TextareaMode::Extras` is now `TextareaExtras` instead of `()`. Only code that names this associated type is affected. ([#3970](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3970))
  ```diff
  - type Extras = ();
  + type Extras = TextareaExtras;
  ```
- **Input**: `EditorState::text_gutter_margin()` is replaced by `text_origin_offset() -> Option<Pixels>`. ([#3765](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3765))
- **GPUI Fast 0.1.16**: every `Element` now gets `IntoElement` from GPUI Fast itself. Apps built on the `gpui-fast` feature must drop their own `impl IntoElement for X { type Element = Self; ... }` on element types, or they will not compile. The default gpui-pre backend is unchanged.

## New APIs

- **Layout**: global right-to-left layout direction. ([#3886](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3886))
- **Motion**: an explicit reduced-motion preference. ([#3881](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3881))
- **Select, Combobox, Command**: opt-in `highlight_matches`, with a new `list.highlight.foreground` theme color. ([#3959](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3959), [#3960](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3960))
- **Input**: `set_tokens` and text decorations on `TextareaState`, `context_menu_offset`, and the editor text origin offset. ([#3971](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3971), [#3970](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3970), [#3920](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3920), [#3765](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3765))
- **Table**: `TableRow::id`, `TableRow::hover`, and `DataTable::scrollbar_mode`. ([#3907](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3907), [#3912](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3912), [#3945](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3945))
- **Text**: `TextView::link` to replace or drop links, and an option to keep raw HTML in Markdown as text. ([#3743](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3743), [#3979](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3979))
- **Components**: `Checkbox::indeterminate`, `SidebarGroup::suffix`, `NumberInput` stepper option, `Diff::split_ratio`, `MessageScroller::scroll_to_offset`, `SelectableText` highlights, and tooltip anchor offsets. ([#3980](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3980), [#3982](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3982), [#3748](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3748), [#3883](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3883), [#3922](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3922), [#3929](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3929), [#3874](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3874))
- **Locales**: Japanese. ([#3976](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3976))

## Editor and text input

- Move the caret and delete by grapheme cluster; reveal the caret after a long single-line paste; report a preedit kept by `unmark_text` as a change; keep IME candidates on the matching row. ([#3887](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3887), [#3967](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3967), [#3965](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3965), [#3939](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3939))
- Hit-test past the gutter, open completion menus above the caret when they do not fit below, let Copy with no selection reach the window selection, keep the tab indicator inside its tab. ([#3921](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3921), [#3925](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3925), [#3915](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3915), [#3983](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3983))
- Textarea: no newline on secondary Enter, and no scrolling at fractional scales while auto-growing. ([#3879](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3879), [#3882](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3882))

## Markdown and text rendering

- Fold white space as HTML does, parse `<pre>` as a code block, lay out several images inline, and number list items correctly after a sub-list. ([#3949](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3949), [#3899](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3899), [#3898](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3898), [#3876](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3876))
- Code spans: count oversized insets once per line, keep leading white space beside a fold. ([#3972](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3972), [#3962](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3962))
- Selection: triple click selects a line or wrapped paragraph, drag auto-scroll starts at an edge that hides text, a press on a control keeps the selection, a cursor set on `TextView` replaces the I-beam. ([#3930](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3930), [#3942](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3942), [#3928](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3928), [#3951](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3951), [#3966](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3966), [#3927](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3927), [#3964](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3964))

## Components

- **Table**: no per-frame redraw of a striped table that does not fill its area, and no per-row cross-axis measure. ([#3978](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3978), [#3868](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3868))
- **Tooltip**: animate width between tooltips, wrap long text within `max_w`, show one tooltip when nested in a native `.tooltip()`. ([#3957](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3957), [#3975](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3975), [#3896](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3896), [#3914](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3914))
- **Diff**: keep split columns beside a long line, keep the header in view when switching modes, collapse many files in one rebuild. ([#3958](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3958), [#3884](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3884), [#3935](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3935))
- **Button**: spinner on a loading button without icon, no focus on right/middle press, no hover style while disabled. ([#3908](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3908), [#3924](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3924), [#3943](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3943))
- **Select, Popover, Dialog, Dock, Settings, Slider, Attachment, Tabs, Title bar**: keep menu height while searching; keep a popover open for clicks in its child popup; offset stacked dialogs by open dialogs only; let the skin size a closed dock; fold the settings page from its title; slider keyboard shortcuts; animated GIF previews; roving Tabs navigation; keep a title-bar click that moves a pixel. ([#3944](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3944), [#3909](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3909), [#3897](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3897), [#3931](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3931), [#3947](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3947), [#3919](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3919), [#3903](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3903), [#3900](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3900), [#3918](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3918))
- **Window, WebView, Theme, Native menu**: end mouse gestures when the compositor eats MouseUp, redraw after releasing the composition surface, Windows scrollbar convention, reject bad hex digits instead of panicking, SVG sniffing across a split character. ([#3643](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3643), [#3986](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3986), [#3895](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3895), [#3936](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3936), [#3890](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3890))

## Accessibility

- Expose single- and multi-line input text, labels and disabled inputs to assistive technology; numeric `SetValue` on Slider; a visible label on the copy button; Tab leaves selection controls that become disabled. ([#3818](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3818), [#3894](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3894), [#3937](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3937), [#3877](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3877), [#3963](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3963), [#3910](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3910), [#3872](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3872), [#3875](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3875))

## Dependencies

- GPUI Fast 0.1.16; gpui-pre stays at 0.3.12.

## Contributors

<details>
<summary>Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release</summary>

@huacnlee, @madcodelife, @shiz92, @JackLuciano, @wangdiandao, @jeonsu0609, @yuluod, @nxtvoid, @kevin9327, @Bombatomica64, @ylinwind, @vinevard, @ualtinok, @Tunglies, @taoqf, @sodekim, @since2006, @shreeve, @sassman, @PanicIsReal, @mycodecrafting, @m-gebhardt, @Map1en, @kossoy, @iam4x, @Elitelord, @davonium, @costajohnt, @bet4it, @aetoskevin.

name: v18.20.3
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the public `isXdDevicePath` export from `providers/cursor-pi-args`. Ranged reads of `xd://` documents now use the standard line-selector behavior.

### Fixed

- Fixed rate-limit handling for Mistral and other OpenAI-compatible providers so requests with no available allowance fail immediately with an actionable error suggesting a model or plan change.
- Fixed Anthropic OAuth requests for pooled Claude accounts to report accurate device and account information, including after credentials are rotated during a request.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added publicly available image-sizing helpers for determining model-delivered image dimensions and fitting images to a specified long edge before coordinate mapping.

### Fixed

- Fixed image inputs being dropped for DeepSeek V4 Flash, restoring consistent multimodal image support.
- Restricted reasoning-effort options for Mistral GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, and Mistral Large 4 to the levels supported by those models.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- Renamed the browser `tab.clickAt()` option from `clickCount` to `count`, matching `tab.click()`.
- Browser viewport screenshot coordinates now use the displayed image coordinates when the screenshot is scaled for the model; pass `css: true` (or `{ x, y, css: true }` for drag points) to provide viewport CSS pixels explicitly.
- Added opt-in `mnemopi.recallRelevance` (`off`, `auto`, or `on`; default `off`) to filter automatic memory recall for task relevance using the `judge` role.
- Added path-scoped entries for `bash.patterns` and `bashInterceptor.patterns`, resolved per working directory. Project and `--config` overlays now prepend these rules to global rules instead of replacing them.
- Added `bash.allowedEnvVars` and per-rule `env` lists to permit explicitly named environment-variable prefixes on matching `allow` rules.
- Subagents now preserve `@upstream` provider pinning on inherited models.
- Added `--no-judge`, `--no-spotlight`, and `--offline` options to restrict auxiliary services to the active model's provider or disable cross-provider services.
- Added per-rule TTSR `repeatMode` frontmatter (`once`, `after-gap`, or `always`) to override the global repeat policy.
- Compound bash approval prompts now show each command segment separately, distinguishing allowed segments from those requiring approval.
- Removed the `seance` agent, `/seance` command, and the task tool's `sourceSession` parameter.

### Added

- Added `mnemopi.embeddingQueryPrefix` and `mnemopi.embeddingInputType` configuration for asymmetric and instruction-tuned embedding models, including providers that require an `input_type`.

### Changed

- Browser screenshots are delivered to the model in CSS pixels up to the supported unscaled size, making viewport screenshot coordinates directly usable with browser actions; scaling guidance remains for scaled full-page and element captures.
- Browser `waitForUrl`, `waitForResponse`, and `requests({ filter })` now support `*` glob patterns in URL strings, while other strings retain substring matching.
- The WebKit browser engine now automatically installs and updates to the newest stable ABKit release, with versioned installations that allow updates without waiting for existing browser hosts to exit.
- Improved browser responsiveness and recovery: unresponsive WebKit pages fail fast with actionable errors, navigation can recover busy pages, and browser operations provide clearer diagnostics for timeouts, closed tabs, unsupported event listeners, invalid routes, cookie data, and viewport changes.
- Pressing Delete at the end of the Ctrl+R search field removes the selected prompt from history.
- `/copy` now works while viewing a subagent and copies from that subagent's transcript.
- `find` now returns unranked literal keyword matches when all judge requests fail.
- `take()` and `drop()` now reject nonexistent hunk units with a clear error.
- `edit` rejection messages now suggest the file's current tag, and edits made before conflict resolution carry over to the resolved file.
- `/marketplace` and marketplace install/uninstall commands now report picker and catalog-load errors without exiting the session.
- ACP sessions honor `mcp.startupTimeoutMs` for MCP servers declared by the client, and ACP form elicitations no longer repeat field labels unnecessarily.
- Task progress from every `task.steps` subagent step is now preserved, rather than only the final step's report.
- Pasting HTML into the composer now preserves spaces from whitespace-only inline elements and indentation inside `<pre>` blocks.
- Queued follow-ups edited with Alt+Up are restored as queued messages instead of being sent into the active turn.

### Fixed

- Fixed `ida` `exec` output on IDA 9.5+ by suppressing helper deprecation warnings and preserving the updated function metadata API.
- Expired Perplexity logins and cookies no longer return an error page as a search answer; the provider is reported as expired and the search chain continues.
- Fixed browser WebMCP discovery and invocation on Chrome and Chromium 157 and later.
- Private hosts written with a trailing dot are now correctly handled by Ask and `always-ask-cached` before file tools access them.
- Fixed the TUI freezing when switching sessions from an open tool-approval prompt.
- Fixed `/commit` and eval `commit` dropping UTF-8 BOMs or mishandling quoted and Unicode filenames during change tracking and selective commits.
- Fixed misleading Wayland clipboard warnings when pasting an image or when the clipboard is empty.
- Fixed JavaScript evaluation after an in-place Linux upgrade by keeping session workers tied to the session's build.
- Deleting a session that cannot be removed no longer deletes its prompt history and statistics.
- Fixed `read` and `write` handling of line selectors on `xd://` device URLs.
- Fixed `eval wait()` rejecting or mishandling numeric delays; browser waits now direct users to the appropriate wait helpers.
- Fixed browser `open` with an existing Arch Chromium profile, Tern navigation, closed external Tern blocks, and docked Tern viewport emulation.
- Fixed Tern and WebKit browser calls that incorrectly exposed unsupported page event-listener APIs; errors now identify the supported alternatives.
- Fixed browser timeout and busy-page errors to include the current URL, affected tab, and actionable recovery guidance.
- Fixed Mnemopi embedding failures being silently downgraded to keyword search; provider errors now produce a warning, including in print mode on stderr.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Added

- Added configurable embedding query prefixes and input types for instruction-tuned and asymmetric embedding models, including Qwen3-Embedding, E5, and NVIDIA NIM.
- Added the `embeddings.onRequestFailed` callback, allowing hosts to handle and surface failed embedding API requests.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Committing or writing trees now correctly reports unresolved index conflicts instead of silently omitting conflicted files.
- Fixed shell compatibility with GNU `grep` for end-of-line-anchored patterns, including `-o` and `-z` modes, and corrected `sed` substitutions on multibyte-character lines.
- Fixed native diff and patch handling for filenames containing spaces and other characters requiring quoting, including binary changes.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Fixed

- Fixed HTML-to-Markdown conversion for fetched and pasted HTML to preserve whitespace in inline elements, maintain code indentation in preformatted blocks, and avoid inserting stray blank lines between block elements.


## What's Changed
* fix(edit): offer the current tag for the rows shown when a header tag is unknown by @Xytronix in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19332
* fix(approval): gate private hosts written with a trailing dot by @XYZ1024-alt in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19228
* fix(find): list literal keyword matches when every judge request fails by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19231
* fix(browser): launch Chromium with the WebMCP feature enabled by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19232
* fix(coding-agent): kept retained snapshots when a conflict:// write resolves a block by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19233
* fix(coding-agent): report /marketplace picker load failures instead of crashing by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19234
* fix(browser): reuse Chromium started through a compiled launcher by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19235
* fix(coding-agent): closed pending tool approval when the turn aborts by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19242
* fix(coding-agent): kept the JS eval worker on the running build after an in-place upgrade by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19259
* fix(coding-agent): stopped Ctrl+V on Wayland warning about a missing xsel when the clipboard holds no text by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19260
* fix(builtins): stop sed panicking on empty matches inside a character by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19261
* fix(grep): match -o and -z end anchors at the end of the line by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19262
* fix(utils): keep whitespace-only inline elements and <pre> descendants in turndown by @tuschla in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19263
* fix(advisor): preserve skill-prompt user text past the body cap by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19267
* fix(session): purge database rows only after transcript deletion by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19271
* fix(vcs): preserve filenames across native diff and patch round-trips by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19274
* fix(ai): derive Claude device identity from the serving account by @Xytronix in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19277
* fix(acp): honor mcp.startupTimeoutMs for client-declared MCP servers by @Alex-Wengg in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19286
* fix(catalog): use Mistral's documented effort ladders for GLM 5.3 and Large 4 by @Alex-Wengg in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19287
* fix(catalog): kept image input on deepseek's v4-flash alias by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19289
* fix(ai): failed fast on 429s with a zero x-ratelimit-limit allowance by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19301
* fix(coding-agent): kept a dequeued follow-up queued on resubmit by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19306
* fix(acp): dropped field questions from form elicitation message by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19307
* fix(vcs): reject unresolved index entries before creating commits by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19309
* fix(commit): reject unknown hunk unit ids by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19310
* fix(commit): kept utf-8 bom in selective commit blobs by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19330
* fix(coding-agent): allow /copy in focused subagent view by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19373
* feat(mnemopi): filter automatic recall for task relevance by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19132
* feat(mnemopi): support asymmetric embedders and surface embedding failures by @YibaiMeng in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19322

name: ctx7@0.12.0
body:
### Minor Changes

- 6515def: Add `ctx7 get-upgrade-guide <libraryId> <fromVersion> [toVersion]`, the CLI counterpart of the `get-upgrade-guide` MCP tool. It prints the guide between two versions of a library, with `--page` for long guides and `--json`, and exits with code 75 while the guide is being prepared.

### Patch Changes

- 7d8781b: `ctx7 login` and `ctx7 whoami` no longer hang on a stalled host: the identity check times out after 30 s, and an OAuth answer whose body stalls after the headers ends with the same clear timeout message as a stalled connection.
- 76511d5: `ctx7` API calls now time out instead of hanging on a stalled connection: `ctx7 code` after 70 s (the server waits up to 40 s for a first index), the other commands after 60 s, also when the answer stalls after its headers. Login and token refresh calls time out after 30 s, and the usage ping after 3 s, so a stalled host no longer keeps `ctx7` running. A timeout prints a clear error and exits 1.
- 8fc3f6d: When stdout is piped, `ctx7` writes warnings, errors and their hints to stderr, so `ctx7 code ... | grep x` still shows the "being indexed" notice and errors. `--json` output stays on stdout.
- d80a84c: While a library's source is being indexed, `ctx7 code` and `query-code` now say to call again for up to 3 minutes instead of at most twice: a first index usually takes 1 to 3 minutes. When the server message already gives this rule, the clients no longer repeat it.

name: @upstash/context7-sdk@0.7.1
body:
### Patch Changes

- 4087030: The SDK now reads a JSON response when the server sends a mixed-case `Content-Type`, such as `Application/Json`. Before, `searchLibrary()` threw a `TypeError` on such a response. Lookalike types such as `application/jsonp` stay on the text path.

name: @upstash/context7-mcp@4.7.1
body:
### Patch Changes

- d80a84c: While a library's source is being indexed, `ctx7 code` and `query-code` now say to call again for up to 3 minutes instead of at most twice: a first index usually takes 1 to 3 minutes. When the server message already gives this rule, the clients no longer repeat it.
- d53d88d: The research preview is now called experimental tools. Each signed-in user picks the experimental tools to list at Settings > MCP Tools in the Context7 dashboard, where "All experimental tools" also includes tools added later. The old flags (`--research-preview`, `CONTEXT7_RESEARCH_PREVIEW=1`, `?research_preview=1`) and the new `--experimental`, `CONTEXT7_EXPERIMENTAL=1` and `?experimental=1` still turn on every experimental tool.
- 6e469e3: Update `@modelcontextprotocol/node` to 2.1.2 and `@modelcontextprotocol/server` to 2.4.0, which bring in security fixes for `@hono/node-server`, `hono` and their dependencies.
- 0718ba8: `query-code` no longer greps a docs-style `query` of several words, which matched nothing: it answers with a correction that `pattern` is a regex matched within one line. A one-word `query`, or a phrase with `fixed_strings`, still works as the pattern. `pattern` now takes up to 1000 characters, like the server.
- c5e26f6: Describe query-code references as name matches, resolved only for libraries with a SCIP index

name: v0.22.8
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.22.8

## Summary

This patch release ships critical fixes for team lock recovery and Stop hook stability. The native Stop hook no longer loops on stale team membership locks, preventing Codex API quota exhaustion reported in #4086.

## Fixed

- **STOP HOOK STABILITY WITH TEAM LOCK RECOVERY (#4087, #4090):** Stop hook now properly detects `team_lock_recovery_required` errors and terminates cleanly with `continue:false` instead of looping. Stale team membership locks are correctly identified as terminal stops, preventing indefinite continuation attempts that could exhaust the Codex API quota. Fixes #4086.
  - **#4087**: Stop hook now halts on `team_lock_recovery_required` instead of looping indefinitely
  - **#4090**: Stale team locks properly output as terminal stops to prevent continuation

## Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`, Cargo workspace, and plugin metadata) all report `0.22.8`.

## Verification

- Full CI on dev candidate (candidate details recorded in [release readiness](docs/qa/release-readiness-0.22.8.md)).
- PR #4087 and #4090 CI passed on merged heads.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@Yeachan-Heo](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo) for contributing to this release.

**Full Changelog**: [`v0.22.7...v0.22.8`](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/compare/v0.22.7...v0.22.8)
