| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.3/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.3-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.3/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.3-linux-x64.deb) | — Linux packages are not code-signed |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.3/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.3-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.3/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.3-android.aab) | ✅ Signed APK; the AAB is the Play Store bundle |
| iPhone | [Unsigned IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta.3/VoiceStudio-0.5.9-beta.3-ios-unsigned.ipa) | ⚠️ Unsigned: sign it with your own Apple ID to sideload; not a TestFlight build |

Setup and model downloads recover more reliably after interrupted transfers, low-space retries and transient connection failures. This beta also improves low-VRAM generation, pronunciation, long-recording transcription, plain-text exports in Dubbing and Transcriptions, and Android downloads.

**Highlights**

- Setup reuses verified wheels and retries transient connection failures; model downloads reject corrupt ranges while preserving valid work
- Low-VRAM GPUs release idle models before generation
- Saved pronunciation entries and inline overrides work across speech, Dub, batch and voice conversion
- Save plain transcripts from Dubbing before or after generation on desktop, or from generated paired-phone results; Transcriptions also exports SRT with genuine cue timings and handles long recordings with duration-scaled limits
- Android downloads work through eligible VPN routes, and installed gated models open their licence review dialog

**Testing wanted:** small-GPU generation under memory pressure; pronunciation in Dub, batch and voice conversion; long-file transcription and text/SRT export; edited Dubbing transcripts before generation and paired-phone TXT sharing; low-space or restricted-network setup; interrupted model downloads followed by Retry; and Android downloads with a VPN and cellular opt-in.

**Known scope:** the low-memory Mac Stories performance report [#4090](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/issues/4090), Stories playback report [#4136](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/issues/4136), legacy Dubbing Method Not Allowed report [#4127](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/issues/4127) and Windows native model-loading crash [#4142](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/issues/4142) remain unresolved. Dubbing TXT export answers the separate plain-transcript request in #4127; it does not repair or establish a retest of the archived v0.3.8 Tauri SRT/405 failure. VoxCPM2 installation report [#4150](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/issues/4150) still needs the original failing step and logs. The playback wording does not fix the underlying Stories failure. Download transport pinning applies to accelerated transfers, rather than all Hub metadata or plain Hugging Face fallback traffic.

**Upgrading:** install over the existing app or use Settings → Updates → Beta. Voices, projects, settings and installed models stay in place. The release workflow adds the download table from actual desktop and phone artifacts, including measured signing results.

### Changed

- Removed an unused legacy update-busy helper while retaining active restart protection (#4149) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired an unused legacy update toast while preserving the active Electron update controls (#4141) — thanks @themrbeasley!

### Added

- Dubbing exports the selected transcript as plain UTF-8 TXT, including edited text before generating a dub, with native Save As and paired phone sharing. (#4155) — thanks @shivamdhiman999111-source!

### Docs

- Track the unresolved VoxCPM2 installation report separately from GPU fallback fixes, reported by [vinhson](https://discord.com/users/1025270992882376704) (#4154)
- Document host-managed Tailscale access for Docker without sharing the host daemon socket (#4111) — thanks @MaverickKB!
- Installation tracking separates shipped fixes, pending repairs and unresolved report evidence (#4121)
- Track the unresolved Windows model-loading crash and distinguish merged installer repairs from released fixes (#4146) — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code!

### Fixed

- Diagnostic bundles and Electron bug reports redact share PINs and encoded credential query parameters (#4151) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The reviewed model-install steps now require the same authenticated consumer as the rest of the model manager (#4152) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- macOS publishing checks Gatekeeper even when Windows installers are explicitly unsigned (#4153)
- Malformed model-install status responses keep the interface open and preserve the last valid download state (#4106) — thanks @ftlcustomerservice73-ui!
- Auto setup can retry PyPI failures through the regional mirror and report the actual failed host (#4107) — thanks @mrkeshi!
- Optional analytics no longer delays backend readiness, and consent changes invalidate queued startup work (#4108) — thanks @cf3901646!
- Update the optional Dagger pipeline's OpenTelemetry dependencies to fix excessive CPU use when parsing malformed trace context. (#4109)
- URL imports restore their connection guard after temporary DNS resolver changes (#4110)
- Long recordings use duration-scaled transcription limits across uploads, dubbing, child engines and MCP tools (#4112) — thanks @xabiherdz-svg!
- Stop cancelled setup retries promptly and keep verbose runtime probes from blocking on their diagnostic output. (#4113)
- Saved and inline pronunciation choices apply consistently across speech, dubbing, batch and voice-conversion routes (#4114) — thanks @nntloc!
- Reuse verified setup wheels on low-space retries and handle interrupted size probes without an uncaught error. (#4115)
- Model downloads reject damaged files and retry without reusing corrupt ranges, while cancellation preserves verified work (#4116)
- Reclaim idle GPU models before generation when VRAM or RAM is low (#4117) — thanks @vandyahmad24!
- Crash recurrence reports recognize current Electron version fields and distinguish beta releases (#4120)
- Model deletion over the API now requires administrator rights (#4122) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- SoniTranslate installation and start/stop now require a local administrator, like every other engine installer (#4123) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Deleting history, rewriting dub scripts and clearing model-licence receipts now require an administrator, as the API docs already promised (#4124) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Imported project bundles can no longer make ffmpeg fetch remote URLs through a playlist-shaped media file (#4125) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- TTS and event WebSockets now enforce the same loopback/credential rule as dictation, closing a share-PIN bypass (#4126) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- MCP tools preserve remote caller permissions across local and HTTP backends, including failed transport lookups (#4128) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Docker deployments now require the administrator API key for the runtime log, log stream, recent errors and crash report, as the install docs already said (#4129) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- A deterministic test now fails when a new mutating API route ships without an authorization decision (#4130) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The LM Studio model probe no longer sends the stored API key in clear text to a remote host unless plaintext LAN is allowed (#4131) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Segmented model downloads pin public destinations with bounded DNS checks across redirects, ranges and proxies, preventing private-network fallback and CDN credential leaks (#4132) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Cloud sign-in now rejects a discovery document whose token or revocation endpoint is not on the issuer's own origin (#4133) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Transcriptions can save clean plain text and timed SRT captions, with an explanation when subtitle timings are unavailable (#4135)
- Stopped playback errors from incorrectly claiming that generated audio files are missing (#4138) — thanks @AAYUSH-CODER1904!
- Android model downloads resume through VPNs while preserving Wi-Fi policy and saved ranges (#4140) — thanks @JerryTimi!
- Make the installed-model licence action open its terms and acknowledgement dialog — thanks [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/users/1571221621316784260)! (#4147)

### Contributors

- New code contributors since v0.5.9-beta.2: @DeryFerd and @vandyahmad24.
- Code since v0.5.9-beta.2: @debpalash, @DeryFerd, @vandyahmad24.
- Code since v0.5.8: @debpalash, @DeryFerd, @ItzSudhan, @velixio, @b84330808, @blutuxyz, @kevin9327, @RerankerGuo, @hkarmoush, @vandyahmad24.
- Reports, requests and performance feedback: @ftlcustomerservice73-ui, @mrkeshi, @cf3901646, @MaverickKB, @xabiherdz-svg, @nntloc, @AAYUSH-CODER1904 and @velixio.
- Transcriptions and Dubbing plain-transcript request: @shivamdhiman999111-source; Android VPN report: @JerryTimi; cleanup proposal: @themrbeasley; Windows crash report: @renaldyramadani123-code.
- VoxCPM2 installation report: [vinhson on Discord](https://discord.com/users/1025270992882376704), from the [original complaint](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1567177140007608350/1567177140007608350); unresolved, with no GitHub identity attributed.
- Installed-model licence-action report: [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/users/1571221621316784260), from the [original complaint](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1571229026138325102/1571229026138325102); no GitHub identity is attributed.

## Changelog

- feat(add): warn when a GitHub rate limit forces the blob fast path to clone (#2761)
- fix(local-lock): serialize lockfile updates and write atomically (#2750)
- feat(lock): pin lock entries to the installed commit (#2735)
- feat(add): install a skill under a new name with --rename (#2722)
- fix(installer): keep skill links valid when the agent skills dir is a symlink (#2283)

## 2026.11.5-beta.4

### Highlights

### Changes

- **Telegram widgets:** Render interactive widgets as Telegram messages (#196991) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- **Transcripts and attachments:** Keep transcript reads available during concurrent database preparation, release completed SQLite readers without restarting cursors, and avoid inserting binary attachments into model prompts (#188055, #190242, #198309, #198289) Thanks @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @ava-perry, @Yun-0000, @obviyus, and @mulderp82.
- **Automation continuity:** Deliver failed-child results after parent turns end, run late scheduled jobs correctly, preserve in-flight jobs across config changes, and let repair turns inspect their jobs (#197658, #197484, #197606, #197591, #188105) Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @Stronggenetics, and @wupingyuan81-oss.
- **Automation privacy:** Recheck owner-private memory access when queued automation runs start (#198697, #198695) Thanks @daniel-lxs.
- **Claude and approvals:** Recover after CLI cleanup failures, preserve paired-node Gateway context, relay approvals across differing tool-call IDs, and allow configured-primary fallback (#198224, #195431, #145741, #145636, #197853, #197829, #198427, #158421) Thanks @obviyus, @mdarapour, @ZengWen-DT, @bricelb, @gulagala001, @Borekobama, @alkor2000, and @HerbertHuerto.
- **Provider recovery:** Recover OpenAI conversations from compaction item conflicts and saved-context hook overrides, retry newer Claude models with a compatible OAuth client version, and keep OpenRouter requests on their endpoint (#198357, #199451, #196693, #185294, #185272) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, and @vishnusenthil-16.
- **Update safety:** Retry installation discovery, retain run watching across ledger failures, keep plugin lifecycle leases alive during finalization, roll back releases that fail Doctor or startup, and handle moved cron partitions (#188010, #188015, #188404, #197851, #185097) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **Large session memory:** Export memory in bounded pages, finish large-index rebuilds after updates, and avoid unnecessary transcript allocation for native context seeds (#196158, #196132, #196480, #196378, #194545) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, and @garrytan.
- **Telegram:** Deliver inline button taps, keep disabled buttons inactive, preserve topics for approvals and widgets, and include runtime session keys in message hooks (#196217, #126950, #191647, #191645, #198038, #197907, #192162, #125166, #198022, #197923, #197519, #197186, #197669) Thanks @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @obviyus, @kkernan, @aspalagin, @dankarization, @claxman, @Waste2Time, @lester076, @rodricksz4h5, and @tommyjoseph.
- **Mobile and voice:** Deliver captioned Feishu media when block streaming is disabled, avoid the iOS speech-permission crash, and start backing agents for Talk requests (#191585, #196822, #183586) Thanks @forrystudio, @obviyus, @bdjben, and @brokemac79.
- **Control UI:** Prevent retained loading animations from slowing repeated session switches, avoid WebKit picker/menu freezes, and handle chat Details updates without listener errors (#194027, #194146, #198658, #198380) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Gateway resilience:** Bound Matrix formatted-message mention parsing, cancel pending MCP listener work during shutdown, and restore Bonjour discovery in npm installations (#184432, #197119, #199156) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, @zeroaltitude, and @alfredjbclaw.
- **Database recovery and backups:** Compact backups inside staging, inspect engines without copying live databases, preserve corruption diagnostics, avoid repeated report rewrites, restore renamed-agent cold transcripts, and isolate retained or held agent databases without blocking startup (#194230, #194208, #194234, #194209, #194497, #194636, #194621, #196079, #196066, #198145, #190875, #190918, #198180) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @GoatInAHat, @wr-web, @sennyhoney, @chrislro, and @Frosmans.
- **Model selection:** Avoid slow model reads with many configured models (#198837) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Automation chat bindings:** Keep stored automations attached to conversations through edits, branches, and resets, while visibly refusing delivery to closed chats. Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @RomneyDa.
- **Compaction memory:** Bound summary payload ownership and release source data before summaries finish so concurrent sessions do not retain entire transcripts. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- **Rescue diagnostics:** Return completed rescue-command findings instead of losing their output. Thanks @wr-web, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
- **Memory export completion:** Settle streamed export observers after source validation. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.5-beta.3..8649a8f54001e1e88869f83204db54dd9870b8f3 history: 55 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 55 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: v5.1.72
body:
**A thread send now reaches a session that is not running, on this device or on another of your devices, and starts it.** It needs senpi 2026.11.15-2 or later (omo pins it), and device service 0.1.31 or later on both devices for a wake from another device. A reply to a sender on another device reads only that device's sessions instead of the whole account listing; a send to a live session that is paused or holds a Stop answers `queued` with `waiting_on: { kind: "hold", device }`; and `waiting_on.kind` in a `thread_send` result can be `approval`, `hold` or `wake`. ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))

### Changed

- `omo remote enable` now sets the device up in one command after `omo login`. It installs the OmO device service when none runs, registers this omo's agent dir with it, turns remote sessions on, and installs and starts the always-on session host unit. If you signed in before the device service was installed, it also links that sign-in to the service, so `omo login` then `omo remote enable` leaves the device connected. Running it again changes nothing that is already in place (#13594). ([#13602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13602)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- `omo remote status` also shows this device's own units as the service manager reports them: the session host unit (running, enabled, pinned host), the device service's unit, whether the cold-wake entry is in place, and the agent dir omo registers. With `--json` these are a `local` object beside the status fields (#13594). ([#13602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13602)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- Thread gateway: waking a session that is not running is on (#13037). It runs on senpi 2026.11.15-2 or later (omo now pins it), the release whose session release drops a woken session's retained record. A message from another of your devices wakes a session here once both devices run device service 0.1.31 or later. The local omo daemon (`omo daemon run`, or the device service's cold-wake unit) registers this device's agent dir with the device service and takes deliveries as soon as it starts, with no session open. ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the operator daemon declares the delivery consumer as soon as it loads omo, with no session open (#13037 cold wake). `omo daemon run` sends the daemon it ensured senpi's `warm`, so a daemon the device service starts on demand can be handed deliveries before any session runs. A warm that is refused or unsupported prints one line and the run still exits 0. ([#13596](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13596)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the session wake loads from its own sidecar (`extensions/omo-wake.js` behind `#omo-wake-runtime`): the carrier, the delivery consumer and the device-service client never enter the main `omo.js` bundle, which carries only lazy shells; the ensured host's idle-exit setting is read inside the sidecar. ([#13456](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13456)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: waking a session that is not running needs no setting (#13037). A `thread_send` from this machine to a session here that is not running now starts it by default, and the answer is `queued` with `waiting_on: { kind: "wake" }`. `session_wake.same_device` stays in the configuration schema only as an explicit opt-out (`false`), read for the target session's own project. The wake starts on senpi 2026.11.15-2 or later (senpi#6449), which omo now pins. ([#13456](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13456)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: when no operator host is running, a session that is not running still starts (#13037). Before it opens the session, the carrier asks the engine's own `host ensure --policy never`, from omo's daemon launch spec, on the socket `thread_create` uses. A running host is reused whatever its build; one is started only when nothing answers. The ensured host runs with `omo daemon`'s own host environment: the agent directory is named (`OMO_AGENT_DIR`) and the configured `task.host_idle_exit_ms` rides along (`SENPI_RPC_HOST_IDLE_EXIT_MS`) instead of the launch spec's default, and from a source tree the launch spec resolves to the plugin's tracked copy so the CLI is always handed a file that exists. ([#13456](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13456)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: a delivery from another device is no longer gated on the device service's wake switch being told on. While this engine's delivery consumer is served (from its serving acknowledgement, before its startup pending sweep, so a remote row that sweep wakes is never told the gate is off), the carrier opens the session. The consumer serves on senpi 2026.11.15-2 or later with device service 0.1.31 or later, and it no longer reads the wake the service tells: the wake switch it tracked (`wakeAllowed`, the `delivery.wake` event) had no production reader left. ([#13456](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13456)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- The delivery consumer (design 5.4) runs beside the carrier. The engine minimum for a woken session, `MIN_WAKE_ENGINE_VERSION` (A8.1, senpi 2026.11.15-2, the release that drops a released session's retained record), gates the carrier as well. A device service older than 0.1.31 does not carry the delivery protocol, so on it the consumer serves nothing and does not ask again. ([#13455](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13455)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- The gateway store's schema moves to version 12: three nullable columns on deliveries and a unique index on the new ledger id. The first process on this release migrates the store; any process still on the previous build then reports the store's "schema too new" error on its thread tools and inbox drain until it restarts. ([#13208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13208)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: once a build carrying this store ships, every gateway store open runs the schema step to version 13 (one new table, `woken_sessions`) and raises the store's `user_version` for good. An older build, or a rolled-back one, that shares the same agent directory then refuses to open that store with its "schema too new" error until it is upgraded again. ([#13212](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13212)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- A reply to a message that came from another of your devices goes to the session on that device that sent it, whether you reply by its session id or by the name it gave. A session on another device, or on this one, that only carries the same id or name no longer receives the reply. ([#13218](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13218), part of [#13037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13037)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))

### Fixed

- An omo engine on a device whose device service runs on a non-default `--state-dir` now registers with it: `deviceServiceStateDir` takes a non-empty absolute `OMO_DEVICE_SERVICE_STATE_DIR`, then the `device-service.location.json` discovery file beside the default dir, and only then `~/.omo/device-service` (#13597). ([#13598](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13598)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- A remote worktree remove refused for an empty reflog now says reflogs may be off in the repository, instead of claiming they are: an expired or deleted reflog looks the same (#13542 follow-up). ([#13546](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13546)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- Thread gateway: the session wake keeps working after the session that started it ends (#13037). The carrier and the delivery consumer are one per agent directory for the whole process, but they used the first session's gateway store, which that session's shutdown closed, so every later wake in the process failed. The running wake now opens its own store for the life of the process. ([#13596](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13596)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the carrier re-checks the sender's peer admission at the moment of every open of a row from another device (#13456 review follow-up), so the retry and lease-takeover paths - which the accept-time check of the consumer and the before-turn check of the drain bracketed but nothing else covered - start nothing when the answer is refused or unknown. A lease takeover now consults the same allowance a wake does, ending its record when nothing queued allows the open; the runtime answers the carrier's admission ask on the live delivery port, so the startup pending sweep's own wakes are admitted too. ([#13511](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13511)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the session wake loads from its own sidecar (`extensions/omo-wake.js` behind `#omo-wake-runtime`): the carrier, the delivery consumer and the device-service client never enter the main `omo.js` bundle, which carries only lazy shells. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: a consumer failure that changes kind (a device that answers nothing and then refuses the declaration) is warned again: the retry loop's one-warning rule is keyed on the failure itself, not on merely being down, and still stays silent while the same failure repeats. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the delivery consumer listens before it declares itself, so the records the device service hands it right after the acknowledgement are no longer dropped. It counts as serving from that acknowledgement, so a session it wakes during its own start is opened, not left switched off. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the delivery consumer is started again after it dies (#13457 review): a device service that answers nothing, refuses the declaration, or restarts under a served connection no longer leaves remote wake off for the engine's life. A failed start closes its port and reports itself, a connection that ends during the startup sweep leaves no stale serving consumer behind, and a connect failure the client reports is logged instead of dropped. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the wake switch the service tells (`delivery.wake`) has no reader since the carrier's gate moved to the consumer serving, so the consumer no longer tracks it. The conformance fakes the production-port test uses are now a package export of `device-service-core` instead of a deep path into its test tree. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: a delivery id that the same device repeats after its 30-day receipt expired, while its row is still in the store, is answered from that row as deduplicated instead of failing with a raw unique-constraint error (the review of #13208). ([#13212](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13212)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: a session whose file header cannot be read, or names a session kind this build does not know, is never started or reopened unattended. It is refused like a child or worker session instead of being treated as an ordinary interactive one (#13037). ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- When another device refuses to wake a session there that is not running, the reason its delivery consumer gives is shown only when it is a short machine code; any other reason is shown as `unrecognised`. ([#13277](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13277), part of [#13037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13037)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))

### Added

- `omo remote bootstrap` and `omo remote enable` install and start one fixed, always-on per-user unit beside the OmO device service that runs the omo session host: the systemd user unit `omo-session-host.service` on Linux (enabled, restarted after every exit) and the LaunchAgent `ai.omo.session-host` on macOS (run at load, kept alive). It runs `omo daemon run --pinned` for the registered agent dir, and the device service's `OMO_RELAYD_SERVICES` table names it (entry `"omo"`) as the only unit it may start for a cold wake. The table keeps its other entries, and the device service restarts only when the table changed. `omo remote disable` disables and removes both, and while remote sessions are off a bootstrap removes them instead of installing them (#13594). ([#13595](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13595)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- `omo daemon run --pinned` starts the operator host with no idle exit; a task host started from one of its sessions still idles out as usual (#13594). ([#13595](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13595)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- Device service client: the delivery-consumer requests of #13037 (`deliveries.serve`, `delivery.answer`, `delivery.held`, `delivery.pending`, `delivery.drained`, `peer.admitted`) and their events (`delivery.inbound`, `delivery.holds`, `delivery.wake`), in the shapes omo-relay-daemon #1076 ships, behind `connectDeliveryConsumer` in `device-service-core`. The conformance fixtures are copied in-tree from that release. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the engine's delivery consumer now connects to the device service through that client, so a delivery from another device for a session here that is not running is taken in, answered, and the session started. ([#13457](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13457)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the session wake now loads from its own sidecar, `extensions/omo-wake.js` behind `#omo-wake-runtime`: the carrier and its host connection, the delivery consumer and the device-service client never enter the main `omo.js` bundle, which carries only three lazy shells (the session-start start, a send's same-device wake, the control endpoint's admission ask); a sidecar that fails to load answers as if no wake exists. Measured 1,547,852 -> 1,476,860 bytes on this branch; the byte ceiling in `bundle-budget.json` moves to 1,478,000 for it. ([#13455](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13455)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the session wake of #13037 now runs in production, but only on an engine at or above the wake engine minimum `MIN_WAKE_ENGINE_VERSION` (A8.1): the first engine release that drops a woken session's retained record (senpi#6449). Below it no carrier starts, and a `thread_send` naming a session that is not running answers as it did before the wake existed (`queued_offline` with `reason: "wake_unavailable"`). At or above it, every `tui` or `rpc` engine (never a task child, never under CI) starts one carrier per agent directory on its first session start: it opens the session by path on the operator host that `thread_create` opens on, sends the engine's `wake`, and hands it back quietly once it has finished; the answer is then `queued` with `waiting_on: { kind: "wake" }`. It still follows `session_wake.same_device`, read for the target session's own project, which stays off by default. ([#13455](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13455)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the carrier sweeps its woken rows on a timer only while the table holds a row (design A3.1.4: an empty table leaves no timer). ([#13455](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13455)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: a session's own inbox drain admits nothing while a carrier is opening it (A3.1.5). It asks the device service whether a row's sending device is admitted before it takes in a delivery from another device (5.6). ([#13455](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13455)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the store can take in a delivery that another device's service attested for a session on this device that is not running (the intake row of #13037). The row is committed in the same transaction as a same-device delivery, keeps the sender's delivery id, text and display text, is rate-limited per sending device, and is admitted later under the engine's own ledger key, so the engine counts it once even if the same delivery also arrives live. A repeat of a delivery id from the same device is answered with the first answer. A reply to such a delivery continues its chain. ([#13208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13208)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the store keeps a record of each session a wake asked for or opened (#13037): one row with its state, a lease and a generation that fences every write, at most 4 such sessions past `requested` per agent directory, and a transient open failure that returns the row to `requested` with its attempts and the time of the next one (the third deletes it). A wake primitive resolves a durable id to its one session file, refuses child and worker sessions, ensures the host and sends one plain `open_session` frame (no `attended`, no permission preset). ([#13212](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13212)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- Thread gateway: the pieces that will let a message from another of your signed-in devices reach a session that is not running on this device are the delivery consumer, the carrier that opens such a session in its own working directory and hands it back when its turn is done, and the pending sweep (#13037). ([#13220](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13220)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))
- `omo remote wake [on|off|default]` reads or sets whether sessions on this device that are not running may be started by a message from your other signed-in devices; `default` follows the build's default, which is off. It needs device service 0.1.31 or later; on an older one the command sends nothing and says so. ([#13257](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13257), part of [#13037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13037)) ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))

name: v5.1.71
body:
The builtin `architect` category now defaults to Claude Fable 5.2 at thinking level `xhigh` instead of `max`: both chain rungs (the 5.2 lead and the 5.1 fallback, kept as the fallback at the same effort) carry `xhigh`, verified against the engine model catalog per the #9378 rule. Docs that spell the builtin default follow. Other categories, agent chains, and model profiles are unchanged (#13543). ([#13545](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13545)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))

**Memory sync names the last unexplained "authority is unavailable" causes, and its log stays free of memory text.** When closing a sync operation, releasing its claim, or the request handler itself failed, Settings still showed the bare "Memory sync authority is unavailable." with nothing in the log. These now carry a code (`close_failed`, `release_failed`, `handler_failed`) and log a warning. Logged errors name the error type, not its message; only a sync service error keeps its service code and status, because other messages can quote memory content. A device or pending-request read whose failure returns after the service refused a request is logged again. Carried by the next train top's bundle regeneration. ([#13332](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13332), follow-up to #13157) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))

**A signed-out desktop no longer looks like a memory-sync error to the engine.** When the desktop had no signed-in account, the engine's main thread treated the desktop's refusal as a broken channel and the sync runner reported an error; it now reads it as signed out, as session Workers already did, and picks up the account once you sign in. Carried by the next train top's bundle regeneration. ([#13329](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13329), follow-up to #13325) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))

**Memory sync keeps working when you sign out and back in on the desktop.** Signing out and signing in again (with the same or another account) while the engine runs used to leave Settings > Memory > Sync on "Memory sync authority is unavailable." until the engine restarted. The engine now ends only the old account when the desktop retires it, ends that account's open sync sessions once, and picks up the new account on the next status read. It needs a desktop that keeps the private channel open across the rollover; with an older desktop the behaviour is unchanged. Carried by the next train top's bundle regeneration. ([#13327](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13327), fixes #13325) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))

**`omo remote` accepts `--` to end its options.** `omo remote send <device>/<session> -- --text that starts with dashes` now sends that text, and the same works for a model id given to `omo remote model`; before, any argument starting with `--` was refused as an unknown option. Options before `--` still apply. ([#13496](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13496), fixes #13431)

**The `omo remote` reference matches the command again.** It lists `open`, `send`, `model`, `interrupt` and `close` with their flags, and describes `attach` as a view you can type into; it no longer says the attach view is observe-only. The Senpi plugin README lists all 27 skills it ships (it said 19). ([#13492](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13492), fixes #13433)

**`omo remote --help` and `omo remote <command> --help` now answer.** They print the usage (or that command's entry with its flags) on stdout and exit 0, before any sign-in or device-service check, instead of failing as an unknown argument. `omo --help` lists `remote` among the commands. `-h` now also answers as a help flag after any verb, including in a value position (for example `omo remote open dev --project --help` prints help instead of taking `--help` as the project name). ([#13489](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13489), fixes #13405)

**omo-opencode tests no longer depend on the order test files run in.** Under bun, module mocks leaked into later test files whenever files ran in sorted order (as `bun test --shard` runs them): six tmux-utils tests replaced modules with partial mocks, two modules that tests mock re-exported functions (the team-mode member resolver's dependencies and the legacy plugin toast's entry migrator), and two claude-code-hooks tests module-mocked shared modules. The tmux mocks are now complete, those two modules define their own forwarding functions so a mock of them stays scoped, and `dispatch-hook.test.ts` and `execute-http-hook-security.test.ts` use spies that are restored after each test. Tests, plus two forwarding-only source changes (`features/team-mode/team-runtime/resolve-member-dependencies.ts` and `hooks/legacy-plugin-toast/plugin-entry-migrator.ts`); no runtime behaviour changes. ([#13333](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13333), fixes #13331)

### Changed

- OmO now pins `@code-yeongyu/senpi` and its packages at 2026.11.15. That senpi release brings the permission-prompt abort fix, the tool-result slash-command injection fix, sign-in-with-ChatGPT scope and input fixes, and the binary update that reads the GitHub release. ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Daily · Normal now walks Claude Opus 5.5 (medium), then Claude Fable 5.2 (medium), then Kimi K3.1 Pro (max), matching senpi's shipped Opus 5.5 fallback chain; GLM 5.3 is no longer a Daily · Normal rung, so a GLM-only setup gets no automatic Daily · Normal model (#13562). ([#13562](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13562)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Daily · Heavy runs Claude Fable 5.2 at high (was xhigh); its Fable 5.1 rung stays at xhigh (#13562). ([#13562](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13562)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `@oh-my-opencode/utils` no longer exports `migrateConfigFile` from its package root or from its migration entry point (`@oh-my-opencode/utils/migration`): the re-export in `packages/utils/src/migration.ts` is removed, and the root entry re-exports that module. Nothing imported it through either entry. The function itself is unchanged. ([#13544](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13544)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Internal: `omo remote` status and session commands now read the account without loading the code that signs in or refreshes, and reach the device service through the local API client directly. Nothing changes for users; this prepares a faster start for these commands (#13440). ([#13477](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13477)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- The gateway store's schema moves to version 12: three nullable columns on deliveries and a unique index on the new ledger id. The first process on this release migrates the store; any process still on the previous build then reports the store's "schema too new" error on its thread tools and inbox drain until it restarts. ([#13208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13208)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread gateway: once a build carrying this store ships, every gateway store open runs the schema step to version 13 (one new table, `woken_sessions`) and raises the store's `user_version` for good. An older build, or a rolled-back one, that shares the same agent directory then refuses to open that store with its "schema too new" error until it is upgraded again. ([#13212](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13212)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- The standalone `omo` binary starts about 4x faster on Linux and 6x faster on macOS: release binaries now carry Bun's bytecode cache, so a launch no longer parses the whole bundled program first (`omo --version` 880 ms -> 202 ms on Linux x64, 214 ms -> 33 ms on Apple silicon). Each binary is about 43 MB larger, and the per-binary size budget rises from 210 MiB to 260 MiB. ([#13464](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13464))

### Fixed

- The remote worktree remove guard's comment no longer claims a failed open's worktree always has exactly one reflog entry: a repo with `core.logAllRefUpdates` off reports none even for a branch just made, so there the worktree is refused `worktree_left_behind` and stays for its local owner; a test pins that refusal (#13450 follow-up). ([#13542](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13542)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- The bundle marker digest no longer folds the running node's `builtinModules` into the digested build settings: the builtin family is recorded as one stable token and only source-derived externals are digested, so a byte-identical bundle built under node 26 (which adds `node:ffi`) no longer reads as stale. A RED test pins the stability and that a source-derived external still changes the digest (#13155). ([#13541](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13541)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- A memory reflection or dream launcher now hears its supervisor's exit even when the supervisor dies while the "launched" receipt is still being written. The launcher used to subscribe to the exit only after that write, so an early supervisor death was never reported and the launcher waited for an outcome that could not arrive: until the run deadline (15 minutes by default), or without a deadline while the run was still queued. The run now fails at once with the supervisor's exit status. ([#13532](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13532)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- An engine registers its agent dir with the device service again when the service stops and comes right back, whether or not the operating system reports the new socket in time. Once its connection had closed, the registrant used to wait for that file notification alone, and on a macOS machine with heavy file activity the notification arrived seconds to tens of seconds late, so the restarted service did not list that engine's sessions until then. The registrant now arms its endpoint watch again once the endpoint it knew is gone, so a service that is listening again within about a second of that is found by the watch's one-second re-check. A service that returns later than that still waits for the notification ([#13531](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13531)) ([#13530](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13530), fixes #12733). ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- An in-process child session's shutdown now waits for the session's own `whenToolChildClosed()` barrier after `dispose()` before its caller removes the directory that child's agent dir lives in, so a still-pending engine writer can no longer recreate that directory after the removal. The split-local, gated-child and permission-event test fixtures gained the same join, plus a held-writer regression case that proves the teardown does not settle while the writer is held (#13522). ([#13522](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13522)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `thread_create` on another device with a file as `cwd` now answers `invalid_arguments` (`not_a_directory`, naming the device and the path) once that device's engine refuses it (`session_cwd_not_directory`, code-yeongyu/senpi#6686), instead of an "update omo" refusal. ([#13488](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13488), refs [#13400](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13400)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread tools: `thread_create` no longer notes that a new thread is outside the caller's workspace when the caller has no workspace at all (scoped addressing then answers `caller_context_missing`, not a workspace refusal). ([#13462](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13462)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- A thread no engine runs on this device (closed, or its terminal exited) answers every thread tool the way a send to it does: `thread_read` reads its session file (`source: "session_jsonl"`), and `thread_interrupt`, `thread_rename`, `thread_set_model` and `thread_set_reasoning` answer `not_resumable`, the same refusal a thread that ended on another device gets, instead of `not_found` while `thread_send` queued to it. ([#13459](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13459)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `thread_create` on this device answers the same thread summary as on another device (id, name, folder, state, times and link) instead of the engine's whole session state. ([#13459](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13459)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `thread_create` on this device in a folder outside the caller's workspace says so: the result adds `workspace_scope: "outside"` and `scope_next_action`, because every thread tool answers that thread `scope_denied` unless `all_scope` is set. ([#13459](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13459)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- A thread tool call that fails (`thread_list`, `thread_send` and the rest, plus extension store tools) now returns `isError: true`, so the engine and the eval bridge report it as failed instead of as a success. The typed failure, with its code and next action, is unchanged. ([#13451](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13451), fixes [#13398](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13398)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- A thread `thread_create` makes on another device is named by its durable id; the relay listing key it returned before answered `not_found` in every later thread tool (#13393). ([#13450](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13450)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `thread_create`'s `cwd`: a relative folder resolves against the caller's folder on this device and is refused on another device, and a folder that does not exist answers `invalid_arguments` naming it, on both devices, instead of `internal_error` or "update omo" (#13400). ([#13450](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13450)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `thread_create` on another device that opened the session but could not name its relay key or apply its name answers the created thread with `thread.warnings` instead of an error, so a retry replays it and a new key cannot create a second session. ([#13450](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13450)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `thread_create { fork_from }` is refused `unsupported` (`details.reason: fork_unsupported`) on both devices instead of opening a blank thread reported as a fork: the engine's `open_session` does not fork yet (#13031). ([#13450](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13450)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread gateway: a delivery id that the same device repeats after its 30-day receipt expired, while its row is still in the store, is answered from that row as deduplicated instead of failing with a raw unique-constraint error (the review of #13208). ([#13212](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13212)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread gateway: a session whose file header cannot be read, or names a session kind this build does not know, is never started or reopened unattended. It is refused like a child or worker session instead of being treated as an ordinary interactive one (#13037). ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `omo remote send` in wait mode printed the previous turn's answer and returned before its own turn settled: the follow printed every `text_delta` it received and settled on the first `agent_settled`, including the attach's replayed history, which over the relay arrives only after `onEvent` returns. A send that started or steered a turn now streams its deltas from the aim on (whatever the attach replayed before the aim is dropped) and settles only at its run's `agent_settled`, so retries and queued follow-ups stream through; a queued send's answer is read from the session's transcript, anchored on the send's own user entry, final when a later message's turn supersedes it or a run settled with it as the tail. A waiting send carries its own `clientMessageId`, which senpi stamps on the user entry it stores, so the anchor holds when a prompt template or skill expansion rewrote that entry's text and never lands on an older send of the same text; an engine that stores no id falls back to the text match. Carried by the next release train top. ([#13272](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13272)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- `omo remote send` in wait mode exited 0 with no output when another device interrupted its turn. It now prints `omo remote: the turn on <device>/<session> was interrupted before it finished.` and exits with the failure code. ([#13272](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13272)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Memory sync settings: when sync cannot read its status, OmO now records WHY. The engine's status path kept one sentence, "Memory sync authority is unavailable.", for every cause, with nothing in the log, so a report of that screen could not be acted on. Each cause now carries a code (`no_account`, `account_aborted`, `account_not_current`, `status_read_failed`, plus `legacy_source` where a source answers with no operation-capable account), together with the step that failed, and it is logged once when it starts rather than on every status poll. The device and pending-request reads and the enable and approve operations, which ended in the same sentence, now carry a code too (`operation_failed` for an unexpected error) and log it with the error; the reads, which the desktop also polls, log once per cause. The message a person sees is unchanged. ([#13157](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13157)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Resolved task planner category config live per plan, caching within the plan window to eliminate redundant disk reads and schema validations during child task spawns, and retaining the last known good configuration only when a reload introduces an error (a file that fails to read, parse or validate) the adopted configuration did not already have; warning-level notices such as ignored unknown keys still apply, and revived tasks no longer report a spurious config generation mismatch after a mid-session edit. ([#9741](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9741), fixes [#9725](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9725)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Claude Fable sessions (`claude-fable-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`, `claude-fable-5-2`, on Anthropic, Bedrock and Anthropic-namespaced gateway routes) now get the same assistant-tail repair as Claude Mythos: when the history ends on an assistant turn, the OpenCode messages transform appends the synthetic user turn instead of sending an assistant prefill the model rejects (#13537). ([#13537](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13537))
- `migrateConfigFile` in `@oh-my-opencode/utils` no longer replaces a config file whose content already equals the migrated output. It used to skip only the backup and still ran the atomic write: a byte-identical replacement that swapped the file's inode and waited on two fsyncs. No current code path calls this function, so the visible effect is in the test suite: the `skips backup when file content is identical after migration` case no longer waits on disk flushes, which is what let it pass the 20 s limit on a host with stalled storage (#11839). ([#13528](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13528))
- `bun run test:fast` releases the serial quarantine's process group only when that phase finished normally. While a shutdown is in progress the PGID is retained, so the SIGKILL escalation still reaches a descendant that ignored the signal: the orphan case the registry exists to prevent. The child registry gained an explicit `release` for a finished group and the serial spawner uses it; a test also pins that no `ROOT_TEST_SERIAL_QUARANTINE` path falls inside the `opencode-memory` or `senpi` group scopes, so the split's disjointness is checked rather than assumed. ([#13518](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13518))
- All three `test:fast` groups now pass the canonical per-file budget, read from `POSIX_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS` in `script/root-test-serial-quarantine.ts`: the same definition the serial phase and the full command use, with no second copy of the value. Without it only the first file of each group got the preload default and every later file fell back to Bun's built-in budget, so a slow file could fail on the budget rather than on its own behaviour. A test asserts the argv actually spawned for each group name, including Bun's flag order for the `--config` invocation. (#12031) ([#13518](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13518))
- When the temporary directory has a group- or world-writable (or foreign-owned) ancestor, omo now stops with one readable line, `omo: trust-tmpdir-unsafe: <dir> is group-writable; run chmod go-w <dir>, or set TMPDIR to a private directory, and start omo again` (exit 78), instead of crashing with `unsafe trust ancestor` and a stack trace (#13503). ([#13510](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13510))
- Contributors: the session-manager storage test removes its temporary storage directory after every test block, so the temp-leak guard no longer reports an `omo-test-session-manager-*` entry. (#13508, fixes #13502) ([#13508](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13508))
- `bun run test:fast` now runs the shared serial quarantine before its three parallel groups, and its `root-rest` group uses `bunfig.win2.parallel.toml`, so the local full-suite path no longer runs the 15 quarantined files concurrently, the condition every CI root-test leg forbids. A failing serial phase returns its own exit code and starts no group. Coverage under the new split is pinned at the config-pattern level by a test: the parallel config adds exactly the quarantine paths over its sibling (file counts measured at this head: 4149 = 15 serial + 1435/965/1734 across the three groups, 0 missing, 0 overlap) (#12031). ([#12031](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12031))

### Added

- `thread_create { worktree: { branch?, base? } }` creates a git worktree for the new thread, on this device or another one, in OmO's worktrees folder there, and starts the thread in it; every failure (not a repository, branch or folder exists, unknown base, no disk space, no permission, git missing, an older omo on the other device) is a typed code with `details.reason` and a next action (#13408). A worktree whose thread then fails to open, or whose `git worktree add` fails part way (including git's timeout), is removed with its branch; what cannot be removed is named in a `partial_commit` failure (`worktree_left_behind`). The worktree request another device answers takes only absolute folders and removes only a worktree inside its own worktrees folder on the branch named. ([#13450](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13450)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread gateway: the store can take in a delivery that another device's service attested for a session on this device that is not running (the intake row of #13037). The row is committed in the same transaction as a same-device delivery, keeps the sender's delivery id, text and display text, is rate-limited per sending device, and is admitted later under the engine's own ledger key, so the engine counts it once even if the same delivery also arrives live. A repeat of a delivery id from the same device is answered with the first answer. A reply to such a delivery continues its chain. Nothing in this release calls the intake yet, so no delivery takes this path. ([#13208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13208)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread gateway: the store keeps a record of each session a wake asked for or opened (#13037): one row with its state, a lease and a generation that fences every write, at most 4 such sessions past `requested` per agent directory, and a transient open failure that returns the row to `requested` with its attempts and the time of the next one (the third deletes it). A wake primitive resolves a durable id to its one session file, refuses child and worker sessions, ensures the host and sends one plain `open_session` frame (no `attended`, no permission preset). Nothing calls the wake yet. ([#13212](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13212)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))
- Thread gateway: the pieces that will let a message from another of your signed-in devices reach a session that is not running on this device are in place but not yet active: the delivery consumer, the carrier that opens such a session in its own working directory and hands it back when its turn is done, and the pending sweep (#13037). Nothing in this release starts them, so a message to a session that is not running is handled as before. ([#13220](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13220)) ([#13279](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13279)) ([#13563](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13563))

name: CC Switch v4.0.33
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.33

本版本修复了从第三方供应商切回 Claude 官方后，已经开着的 Claude Code 会话仍把请求发给上一家、要重开会话才恢复的问题。套餐额度查询新增 **Ollama Cloud**；授权中心的 **Antigravity 账号切换**现在也支持 Windows。

另外修复了 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 的供应商选 Gemini Native 格式时获取模型列表总报「API Key 无效或无权限」；部分服务商获取模型列表被 Cloudflare 拦下；Antigravity Orchestrator 仍有部分请求显示未定价；WebDAV 同步在一些 NAS 上完全用不了；WebDAV / S3 上传失败只显示「请求构造失败」；查询 xAI 额度时遇到网络抖动就被要求重新登录；更新 Skill 中途失败把原来的 Skill 删掉等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.33-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.33-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Ollama Cloud 套餐额度

地址是 `ollama.com` 的供应商现在可以查询 Token Plan 额度（需求见 [#9382](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9382)）：现行套餐显示本期套餐内额度的剩余比例和重置时间，旧版套餐显示 5 小时和每周两个窗口的剩余比例。单独购买的额度不显示；按量付费的账号没有套餐额度，会说明原因。本机运行的 Ollama（`localhost:11434`）没有套餐，不会被识别。

- 新添加或一键导入的 Ollama Cloud 供应商默认开启额度查询；已有的供应商在卡片上点「配置用量查询」，Token Plan 模板会自动选好，打开「启用用量查询」后保存即可。

### Windows 上切换 Antigravity 账号

授权中心的 Antigravity 账号切换以前只支持 macOS，现在 Windows 也能用：切换后 agy 读到的是新账号，Antigravity 官方卡可以绑定账号、查看所绑账号的额度，打开终端前也会提示将切换到哪个账号。Linux 暂不支持。

---

## 修复

- **从第三方供应商切回 Claude 官方后，已经开着的 Claude Code 会话仍把请求发给上一家，要重开会话才恢复**（[#9247](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9247)，见 [#7808](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7808)、[#3057](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3057)）：运行中的 Claude Code 只会读入 `settings.json` 里新增和改动的环境变量，被删掉的仍留在会话里。现在切换时先把要删的地址、凭据和模型映射写成空值，开着的会话下一条请求就不再用上一家，约 10 秒后再从文件里删掉。会话启动时就定下的主模型（`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`）不会跟着变：如果上一家设了它，切回后在模型菜单里选一次 Default，或者新开会话。
- **Claude Code / Claude Desktop 的供应商选 Gemini Native 格式时，「获取模型列表」总是报「API Key 无效或无权限」**：现在按 Google 要求的方式传 Key。经路由的实际请求本来就正常，只有获取模型列表受影响。另外，Pi、Oh My Pi、Kimi Code 选 Google 接口的供应商，获取模型列表以前最多只列出 50 个，现在能列全。
- **获取模型列表时，部分放在 Cloudflare 后面的服务商直接拒绝，被误报为「API Key 无效或无权限」**（[#7429](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7429)，见 [#7427](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7427)）：请求现在默认带上 User-Agent；供应商或请求头里设了 User-Agent 的，仍以设置的为准。
- **Antigravity 选 Orchestrator 时，仍有部分请求显示未定价**（[#9542](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9542)，见 [#9493](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9493)）：显示为「Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Orchestrator)」的步骤按 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的价格计价，近 30 天内的历史也会补上费用。自定义价格仍然优先。
- **WebDAV 同步在部分 NAS 上完全用不了，测试连接、上传、下载都失败**（[#5623](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/5623)，见 [#5621](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/5621)）：这些 NAS 在共享文件夹已存在时仍对「建目录」回 400，以前会直接中止，现在会再查一次目录是否存在。
- **WebDAV / S3 上传被服务器中途断开时，只显示「请求构造失败」**（见 [#9559](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9559)）：现在分清是请求没构造出来还是发送时失败，并附上具体原因，方便判断是网络、TLS 还是服务器的问题。地址里的密码和签名参数不会出现在报错里。
- **S3 自动同步在关掉之后仍可能再上传一次**（[#9528](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9528)）：另一次同步进行中时排队的自动上传，现在开始前会重新读取设置，期间关掉了自动同步或 S3 同步就不再上传。WebDAV 本来就是这样。
- **查询 xAI 账号额度时，遇到网络抖动或 xAI 服务出错就提示需要重新登录**（[#9526](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9526)，见 [#9522](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9522)）：只有登录真的失效才这样提示，临时错误照常报错并保留上次查到的额度，下次查询再试。
- **一个非默认的 xAI 账号过期后，授权中心里选好的默认账号被换成了别的账号**（[#9548](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9548)，见 [#9543](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9543)）。
- **更新 Skill 时如果复制到一半失败，原来的 Skill 被删掉，列表里却仍显示已安装**（见 [#9521](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9521)）：现在新版本完整复制好之后才替换，失败时保留原来的版本。
- **Codex 经路由转成 Chat 格式时，工具定义里的 `required: null` 被要求严格的上游拒绝**（[#7023](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7023)，见 [#7019](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7019)）。
- **macOS / Linux 上 shell 配置文件的路径里带冒号时，「检测到系统环境变量冲突」删除或恢复变量会失败**（[#7170](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7170)，见 [#7169](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7169)）。
- **PIPELLM、AICodeWith、E-FlowCode 的 Pi 预设在模型选择里显示成旧模型名**（[#9514](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9514)）：比如 Claude Opus 5.5 显示成 claude-opus-5，实际请求的是新模型。用这几个预设生成的 DeepSeek Harness、Copilot CLI、Oh My Pi、MiniMax Code、Kimi Code 预设一起修正；已经添加的供应商保留原来保存的名字。
- **地址形如 `api.commandcode.ai/providers` 的供应商被当成 Command Code 套餐查询额度**（[#9518](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9518)）。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo（切回 Claude 官方后开着的会话跟着切换，以及语言列表集中管理）、@ziyangxiami（Hydrogen Orchestrator 计价）、@SailingLoong（获取模型列表的 User-Agent）、@stofancy（WebDAV 兼容 NAS）、@HaiYangBG1（xAI 账号的两处修复、Skill 更新失败时保留原版本）、@GalaxyKW（Codex 工具定义的 `required`）、@cuishuang（环境变量路径里的冒号）、@SaladDay（Pi 预设模型名、Command Code 地址识别、S3 自动同步，以及 WebDAV 与 S3 同步代码合并、语言列表集中管理、前后端常量比对等内部整理）的贡献。

感谢 @Lawgk、@eDramas、@xinluke、@JImmyHui2017、@liuxixiang11、@WindowsXP-PLUS 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。
